It shows how many minutes each has run and how long since the last update, so you can tell “stuck” from “in progress”. 한국어(기본) · 영어 · 일본어 · 중국어 중 하나를 고르면 화면 문구: Choose Korean (default), English, Japanese or Chinese and the UI text and tutorials switch to that language. Tutorials are turned on and off with the switch in the same place.
장소 카드에 6면 전개도가 들어오면 여섯 면을 자동으로 잘라 «6면» 폴: When a 6-face unfolded set arrives on a place card, its six faces are cut automatically and saved as one set in the «6면» (6 faces) folder. Whether it's an unfolded set is decided by all four signs (a cross on a gray ground · six panels · several colors per panel · beams at the four corners); if unsure, nothing happens. If it cuts wrong, turn it off here and cut by hand in the scissors' «Unfolded set 6 faces» tab.
엔진마다 폴더가 갈립니다 — 로라는 학습한 모델에 묶여 있어 엔진이 다르: Folders are split per engine — a LoRA is tied to the model it was trained on, and loading fails outright on a different engine. Type something like «dance» or «anime style» in the search field, press «Search», then «Download» from the results. In the downloaded list, set «Strength» (1 is as trained) and «Default» (used by generations that don't pick one). Bring in files downloaded with a browser via «Choose file», and with a Civitai API key or Hugging Face token stored, the app downloads login-gated ones for you.
«연결» 을 누르면 브라우저가 열리고 코드를 넣습니다. 연결되면 «한 번: Press «Connect» and a browser opens where you enter the code. Once connected, «Generate all» gains «Magnific — generate end-to-end» — from character sheets to scene videos with no hands on, but charged per item. The usual «Set up the generator» (generating yourself in the window) stays as it is. «Test connection» and «Disconnect» are here too.
이 컴퓨터의 GPU·빈 자리를 읽어 엔진마다 «이 기계에서 됩니다 · 줄: It reads this computer's GPU and free space and rates each engine «Runs on this machine · Runs if reduced · Tight · Won't run». «Precision» defaults to auto. «Install» sets up the Python environment; video engines (MiniMax · Wan) also download their weights in full at install time, while the others are tens of GB and download on the first generation. An installed engine has a «Prefetch weights (about N GB)» button to fetch them early. «Remove» deletes only that engine's folder. «Unload worker» frees VRAM.
«기본 목표 크기» 와 «기본» 엔진을 정하면 가위 편집 창 · 6면 세: Set the «Default target size» and «Default» engine and the «Upscale» in the scissors editor, 6-face set cards and the panorama tab uses them. It's a fixed environment unrelated to ComfyUI, though you can hook up an external ComfyUI workflow as an «External engine». Keep «Keep worker after job» on and the next image is faster.
모델 · 플랫폼 · 기법 · 요청문 네 갈래의 md 문서를 보고 고칩니다: View and edit the .md documents in four groups — models · platforms · techniques · requests. «Export all» packs them into one .json and «Import» restores it. When the app's default texts change, only untouched copies are swapped automatically; ones you've edited take the update only when you press «Reset to default».

Each task gets a model (Sonnet 5 — balanced · Opus 5 — quality first · Haiku 4.5 — fast and cheap; GPT-5.6 Terra · Sol · Luna) and a reasoning effort (none · light · normal · deep · very deep). Each provider is saved separately, so switching back and forth to compare keeps the earlier settings. «Defaults» resets.

오른쪽 패널은 탭 셋입니다. «배치» 는 인물·소품·포즈, «환경» 은: The right panel has three tabs. «Layout» is characters, props and poses; «Environment» is rooms, backgrounds and display; «Timeline» is song, motion, GLB and reference video. 화면에서 눌러 고르기 · 왼쪽 끌기 회전 · 오른쪽(또는 가운데) 끌기: Click to select · left-drag to rotate · right- (or middle-) drag to pan · wheel to zoom. Double-click or F moves the orbit center (Ctrl+F to the screen center), and W/A/S/D · Q/E walk the camera (Shift for fine, Alt for big steps). Drop an image, .hdr/.exr or .glb onto the view to register it.
켜고 바닥을 찍으면 고른 인물이 그 자리로 갑니다. 지평선 위·격자 밖은: Turn it on and click the floor to send the selected character there. Above the horizon or outside the grid doesn't work. Pointing at “about there on the lawn” is much faster than nudging x and z one at a time with the gizmo. Select a character in the Layout tab first.

«구도 저장» 은 지금 화면을 찍어 컷에 넘기고 창을 닫습니다. 컷 카드: «Save composition» captures the current view, hands it to the cut and closes the window. A frame image attaches to the cut card and «Read from composition» fills in. The composition image is saved as a file in the project folder and used by the storyboard too.
«다시 찍기» 단추는 없앴습니다. 저장이 곧 찍는 것이라 둘을 나눠 두면: The «Retake» button was removed. Saving is the capture; keeping them separate only left the confusion of “is capturing different from saving?”.
Ctrl+Z 는 창 안 모든 편집에 듣습니다 — 인물 자리, 방 치수,: Ctrl+Z covers every edit in the window — character positions, room dimensions, keys, even inserted motion. Dragging a handle is bundled into one action, so one drag is one undo step.
환경 탭 — 방 세우기, 치수, 돔과 방형, 가릴 면, 전개도·파노라마: Environment tab — building a room, dimensions, dome vs. box, blocking faces, making unfolded sets and panoramas, 6-face sets, room library.
새 컷에는 방이 없습니다 — 구도만 잡는 컷입니다. «실내» 는 여섯 면: A new cut has no room — it's a composition-only cut. «Indoor» is a room to hang six faces on (if a room already exists, the new one stands wall-to-wall on its right); «Outdoor» is a dome wrapped in one panorama (it stands as a 100 m open lot); «Cyclorama» is a product-shot studio joined by a single color, no images. If you only need a background on one side, a «Wall» in the Layout tab is faster than a room.
방을 누르면 그 아래가 펴지고 거기부터가 그 방의 속성입니다. 이름은 두: Click a room and it expands below; from there down are that room's properties. Rename by double-clicking or with the pencil, hide temporarily with the eye, delete with the trash can (Ctrl+Z brings it back). With two or more rooms, «Position» (x · depth · height · rotation°) appears, and you can also grab a room with Shift in 3D and move it.
치수 — 방 크기가 곧 축척: Dimensions — room size is the scale
실내는 가로 · 깊이 · 층고, 돔은 반지름 하나입니다. 밑면이 바닥이라: Indoor takes width · depth · ceiling height; a dome takes one radius. The bottom face is the floor, so characters don't float, and shrinking the room makes characters take up more of it and look bigger than the background. Images are generated at these numbers (meters are stamped into the prompt), so place characters, look, then settle it here.
배경 흐름 — 배경을 움직이게: Background drift — make the backdrop move
면·돔 그림은 정지 이미지라, 그대로 두면 레퍼런스 영상에 배경 움직임이: Face and dome images are still pictures, so by default not a single frame of background motion reaches the reference video. Turn on "Background drift" and set a direction and speed, and the image slides — clouds pass by, the view outside the car window streams backwards. It is off by default; judge the speed by "seconds per full pass".
If the reference background stands still, the video model copies that and freezes the backdrop. Playback, scrubbing the playhead and the reference video all show exactly the same motion for a given time.
배경 영상 — 면에 영상을 걸기: Background video — hang a clip on a face
흐름은 그림 전체가 한 방향으로 미끄러지는 것뿐이라 구름·터널 조명에는: Drift only slides the whole picture one way, which suits clouds and tunnel lights but not passing cars, waves or people. Turn on «Background video», pick a face (a dome takes the whole shell) and hang a clip, and that face really moves. With no clip to hand, «Make a video from this face's image» takes the face image as the first frame, makes a 2–4 second loop and hangs it straight away.
흐름과 따로 켜고 끕니다 — 함께 켜면 흐르면서 움직입니다. 재생·눈금: It is switched on and off separately from drift — turn on both and the clip flows as it moves. Playback, scrubbing the playhead and the reference video all show the frame for that exact time.
호리존 방은 «호리존 색» 을 고르면 여섯 면 전부가 그 색으로 이어집니: In a cyclorama room, pick the «Cyclorama color» and all six faces join in that color. The cut prompt carries it as «seamless solid background (color #…)». Set up the product under «Props in this room» below.
«무엇으로 두를까» 에서 «돔 (파노라마 한 장)» 은 카메라가 제자리에: Under «What to surround with», «Dome (one panorama)» is for a camera turning in place (no seams, no parallax); «Box (6-face set)» is for a camera that moves around (front/back and occlusion hold up). The dome is most accurate from the center at 1.6 m eye height; move away and the floor smears.
실내만 있습니다. 누른 면만 벽이 되어 뒤를 가립니다. «방 밖에서 외벽: Indoor only. Only the faces you press become walls that block the view behind. «See through outer walls from outside» makes just the outer walls that hide a character inside translucent when viewing a room with outer-wall images from outside (on by default). To change over time, set keys on the «Room · blocking faces · props» row in the timeline below.
«이 공간의 장소» 의 «전개도 만들기»(실외는 «파노라마 만들기»)를: Press «Make unfolded set» under «Place for this space» («Make panorama» for outdoor) and a place card with the current dimensions opens in a window. Bring in 360° images made elsewhere with «Import» or by dragging in — 2:1 equirectangular fits best (a 16:9 generated in the app is slightly squashed top and bottom).
잘린 세트를 누르면 여섯 면이 한 번에 걸립니다(«걸림» 표시). 면이: Click a cut set and all six faces hang at once («Applied» marker). A set missing faces leaves those faces empty. «View all images» is the background library window — browse sets and original unfolded sets on a big screen and attach directly to a face.
방에 딸린 배경 소품은 여기서 세웁니다(캐릭터 쪽 소품은 배치 탭). «: Background props that belong to the room are set up here (character-side props go in the Layout tab). «장소 라이브러리 — 관계도 · 보유 에셋» 은 씬 탭에 있던 배경 화면: «Place library — lineage · owned assets» opens the background screen that used to be in the Scenes tab (lineage · other originals · owned assets) as a window. «이름표 — 캡처·영상에는 나오지 않습니다» · «인물 동선» · «배경: Turn «Name tags — not shown in captures or videos» · «Character paths» · «Background brightness — when there is no sky light» on and off. These are view settings only and don't go into the prompt.

부모의 그림을 눌러 레퍼런스로: Click the parent's images to make them references
«이 캐릭터의 생성 이미지·레퍼런스 — 클릭해 레퍼런스에 추가» 줄에는: The «This character's generated images and references — click to add as a reference» row lines up every image the parent has. Click a tile and it goes into this variation's references with «Added» attached; click it again and it comes out (the file stays in the folder). Only the tile marked «Identity reference» can't be taken out — to change it, click the ★ at the top right of another image.
해 볼 것: 타일 하나를 눌러 «추가됨» 이 붙는지 보고, 다시 눌러 빼: Try it: Click one tile to see «Added» appear, then click it again to take it out.
정체성 기준을 빼면 다른 사람이 됩니다. 그래서 바꾸는 것만 되고 빼는: Take the identity reference out and you get a different person. That's why it can only be changed, never removed.
변형 창의 가위 — 잘라낸 칸은 부모에게: The scissors in the variation window — cropped panels go to the parent
변형 창의 그림에도 가위가 붙습니다. 여기서 자른 칸과 지운 판은 «인물: Images in the variation window get scissors too. The panels you cut here and the versions you erased areas from are saved as «character_variation_panelname_crop_001» and move up into the parent's list of generated images. That way you can pick that piece back up as a reference from any variation.
Try it: Hover over an image and just check where the scissors sit at the top right.
배경 변형 창에 파노라마나 전개도가 들어오면 여섯 면이 저절로 잘려 같은: When a panorama or an unfold comes into a background variation window, the six faces are cut automatically and go to the same place. If you turn off «Auto 6-face unfold cutting» in the settings, it won't do it.
변형 지우기 — 자식이 있으면 다릅니다: Deleting a variation — it's different when it has children
변형 카드에 마우스를 올리면 오른쪽 위에 X 가 뜹니다(원본 카드에는 없: Hover over a variation card and an X appears at the top right (original cards don't have one). If no child variations branch off this version, it asks «The original files in the save folder will be deleted too» and deletes that version's files as well. If it has children, that image is their identity reference, so the file is kept and the children are moved up one level.
해 볼 것: 변형 카드에 마우스를 올려 오른쪽 위 X 가 뜨는 자리만 확: Try it: Hover over a variation card and just check where the X appears at the top right. It can't be undone, so here we only look.
«다른 원본» — 같은 인물의 다른 모습: «Alternate originals» — the same character in another form
계보 바로 아래 상자입니다. 어린 시절·노인처럼 같은 인물의 다른 모습을: This is the box right below the lineage. It holds other forms of the same character, such as childhood or old age (seasons or eras for a location), and each original has its own separate variations. When it's empty it only says «No alternate originals yet»; click «Create character» («Create background» for a location) at the end of the box and a new original is created and its editing window opens right away.
해 볼 것: 상자의 설명 줄을 읽고, 지금 다른 원본이 몇 개 있는지 확: Try it: Read the box's description line and check how many alternate originals there are right now.
여기서 만든 것도 전부 주인 폴더 안에 «주인_원본이름_번호» 로 들어갑: Everything you make here also goes inside the owner's folder as «owner_originalname_number» — one folder per character.
원본마다 작은 계보: A small lineage for each original
원본 이름 줄 아래에는 큰 계보와 똑같이 생긴 작은 계보가 붙습니다. 카: Below the original's name row sits a small lineage that looks exactly like the big one. All four things work just as they do in the big lineage: opening a card, «Vary from this card», the variation X, and dropping an image. Variations made here go into the owner's folder as well, under the name «owner_originalname_variation».
해 볼 것: 작은 계보에도 «이 카드에서 변형» 단추가 있는지 확인하세요: Try it: Check that the small lineage also has a «Vary from this card» button.
다른 원본은 한 단계까지만입니다. 더 깊어지면 폴더 하나에 «냥이_어린시: Alternate originals go only one level deep. Any deeper and a single folder fills with endless names like «Nyangi_childhood_baby_…» until you can't tell which one is the owner.
원본 이름 칸과 X: The original's name field and X
이름을 적고 커서가 칸 밖으로 나가는 순간 파일 앞부분(«숲_겨울_…»): Type a name, and the moment the cursor leaves the field the first part of the file names («Forest_Winter_…») follows the new name. If that prefix collides with the owner's variations, owned assets or sibling originals, it's rejected and the name is reverted. The X on the right deletes only that original's references, generated images and variation files, leaving the owner and the owner's variations untouched — original cards have no X, so this is the only way to delete one.
Try it: Type something like «Childhood» in the original's name field.
글자마다 파일을 바꾸면 «어», «어린» 으로 시작하는 파일이 줄줄이 생: If files were renamed on every keystroke, you'd get a string of files starting with «C», «Chil», and the confirmation dialog would keep popping up. So the rename follows only once, when the cursor leaves.
원본 편집 창 — 인물 카드 그대로: The original's editing window — exactly like a character card
원본 카드를 누르면 뜨는 창입니다. 역할·키·프로필·분석·프롬프트 칸이: This is the window that opens when you click an original's card. It has the same role, height, profile, analysis and prompt fields as a character card — childhood is a character too. The «Import analysis» list carries the analyses of the owner and the sibling originals, so you don't have to write out the same character's description again.
Try it: Click an original's card to open its editing window.
닫기(X·ESC·바깥 클릭)가 곧 저장입니다. 다만 이름도 그림도 아무것: Closing (X, ESC, or clicking outside) is saving. But an original with nothing filled in, no name and no image, is deleted the moment you close it — so that empty «Untitled originals» don't pile up.
제작한 시트 타일: Tiles of the sheets you've made
구워 둔 6000×6000 시트가 여기 쌓입니다. 그림을 누르면 화면 가: The 6000×6000 sheets you've rendered pile up here. Click an image to see it full-screen, and hover to bring up buttons in all four corners — top left is «Copy» (to the clipboard) and «To Magnific» (as an image node on the canvas, keeping the file name), bottom left is «Open folder» (it picks that file out in Explorer). The pencil at the bottom right loads that version's layout record back into the sheet window and opens it, and the X at the top right removes it from the list and deletes the png file in the folder as well.
해 볼 것: 시트 그림을 눌러 크게 열어 보세요. «마그니픽으로» 는 밖: Try it: Click a sheet image to open it large. «To Magnific» is the way out of the app, so just note where it is.
배치 기록이 없는 옛 시트에서는 연필이 아예 눌리지 않습니다 — 무엇을: On older sheets with no layout record, the pencil can't be clicked at all — there's no record of what was placed where, so it can't be reopened. In that case, make a new one.
시트 밑 칸에 적는 이름은 «어느 판인지» 알아보라고 붙이는 이름표입니다: The name you type in the field under a sheet is a label so you can tell «which version» it is — things like «Front 3-view» or «12 expression panels». The file name doesn't change; the gray line below it shows the actual file name and specs exactly as they are. Once several sheets pile up, the ones you didn't name can't be told apart later.
Try it: Type something like «Front 3-view» in the name field under the sheet.
This is the window where you place the images on the left as panels, set the layout and specs, and render it all into one image. Right down to moving a single panel, swapping it out and naming it, one at a time.
인물의 전신·얼굴·표정·색 기준을 한 장에 모아 영상 모델에 물리는 시트: Here you put together the sheet that gathers a character's full body, face, expressions and color reference onto one image to feed to a video model. On the left are «Images to place», the layout and the specs; the white board in the middle is the sheet itself. The X at the right of the header («Close») simply closes the window — the panels you placed are saved to the layout immediately so they won't disappear, but if you haven't rendered it, there's still no sheet file.
해 볼 것: 자리만 확인하세요. 누르면 창이 닫히고 튜토리얼도 여기서 끊: Try it: Just check where it is. If you click it, the window closes and the tutorial breaks off here.
칸을 놓고 옮기는 것은 바로 배치도에 올라갑니다. 한 장짜리 그림 파일을: Placing and moving panels goes straight into the layout. The only thing that creates a single image file is «Create sheet».
아직 시트에 안 놓은 그림만 «원본» · «변형 · {변형 이름}» ·: Only the images not yet placed on the sheet are gathered here, in five groups: «Original» · «Variation · {variation name}» · «Alternate originals» · «Owned assets» · «Shared assets». Click a group's header row to collapse it and click again to expand it; the number on the right is how many images that group holds. The groups are kept apart because when character images and props are mixed into one row, you can't tell what you're picking up.
«바닥에 세우기» 를 켜면 단추가 초록으로 바뀌고 3D 화면의 커서가 십: Turn on «Place on floor» and the button turns green and the cursor over the 3D view becomes a crosshair (+). While it is on, clicking the view is not «select» but «move the selected figure to that spot», so the shape of the cursor is exactly «what happens if I click right now». It stays on until you press the button again, so when you are matching the scale of the background and a figure by moving the figure back and forth several times, just leave it on and keep clicking.
해 볼 것: «바닥에 세우기» 를 켜고 커서를 3D 화면 위로 옮겨 십자: Try it: Turn on «Place on floor» and move the cursor over the 3D view to see it become a crosshair. To turn it off, press the same button again.
커서가 그대로면 «클릭이 왜 인물을 옮기지» 가 됩니다 — 모드가 켜진: If the cursor stayed the same you would be asking «why is my click moving the figure?» — the cursor is the only way to tell from the screen that the mode is on.
미리보기를 돌리는 동안에만 3D 화면 왼쪽 아래에 «60 fps» 가 뜹: «60 fps» appears at the bottom left of the 3D view only while the preview is playing — it is re-measured every 0.5 seconds, and it is green at 50 or above, yellow at 28 or above, and red below that. If it drops below 28 the app lowers the resolution one step by itself to prevent stutter, and restores it once it goes above 55. If it stays red, it means the figures, the room or the GLBs are heavy, so hide what you are not using with the eye button for a moment and play again.
해 볼 것: 스페이스로 잠깐 재생해 왼쪽 아래 숫자와 색을 보고, 다시: Try it: Press Space to play for a moment, look at the number and the color at the bottom left, then press Space again to stop.
값이 눈에 보여야 무엇을 줄일지 판단할 수 있습니다. 이 배지는 화면에만: You can only judge what to cut back if you can see the number. This badge shows only on screen — it is not baked into the reference video files you generate.
슬라이더 아래 네 칩은 조작 속도를 한 번에 못 박습니다 — 회전 · 걷: The four chips under the slider pin down the control speed in one go — rotating, walking and zooming all follow this multiplier together. ×0.3 is comfortable when you are lining the camera up on a figure's face in a cramped room, ×2 when you are crossing an open lot 100 m across. Even without changing the chip, holding Shift while walking gives 0.3× (fine), and holding Alt gives 3×, just for that moment.
해 볼 것: ×0.3 을 누르고 화면을 돌려 보세요 — 같은 손놀림에 훨: Try it: Press ×0.3 and rotate the view — the same hand movement turns it far less. Go back with ×1.
회전 감도는 화각에서 자동으로 잡히고 여기서 정한 배수가 그 위에 곱해집: Rotation sensitivity is derived automatically from the field of view, and the multiplier you set here is applied on top of it — the tighter the telephoto view, the slower it gets by itself.
«저장한 카메라» 목록에서 이름을 누르면 그 구도로 카메라가 가고, 두: In the «Saved cameras» list, clicking a name moves the camera to that composition, and clicking it twice lets you rename it — write something like «sign-language close-up» and you will recognize it when you pick a starting composition for a camera move. While editing, Enter confirms, Esc cancels, and clicking once outside the field confirms it as is. The save icon beside it overwrites this composition with the current camera (re-save), and × deletes it.
해 볼 것: 구도 이름을 두 번 눌러 고치고 Enter 로 확정해 보세요: Try it: Click a composition name twice, rename it, and confirm with Enter. For ×, just check where it is. Pressing it asks ««name» — delete it? / The saved composition will be gone. This cannot be undone».
이름을 치는 동안은 창 단축키가 물러납니다 — 스페이스 · K · Del: While you are typing a name, the window shortcuts step aside — Space, K and Delete go in as characters rather than playing or dropping a key.
머리줄의 두 화살표가 되돌리기(Ctrl+Z)와 다시 실행(Ctrl+Shi: The two arrows in the header row are undo (Ctrl+Z) and redo (Ctrl+Shift+Z). It is not written on screen, but Ctrl+Y is redo just the same, so you can use whichever one your hands know from other editing tools. One drag of a handle is one step of undo, and things that are «not an edit a person made» — keys dropped automatically, room rules — do not pile up. While you are typing a name or a number, text undo works as usual instead of the window's undo.
해 볼 것: 인물을 손잡이로 옮긴 뒤 Ctrl+Z 로 되돌리고, Ctrl: Try it: Move a figure with its handle, undo it with Ctrl+Z, then bring it back with Ctrl+Y.
배치 탭의 작은 손잡이들: The small handles on the Layout tab
배치 탭 — 섹션 머리줄 접기·펴기, 숫자칸 ↑↓와 축 하나만 초기화,: Layout tab — collapsing and expanding section headers, ↑↓ in number fields and resetting a single axis, Enter/Esc in name fields, removing mannequins and wall images, group rows, resetting joints, and getting out of the pie menu.
오른쪽 판은 인물 · 소품 · 조명 · 덩어리 · 포즈가 세로로 줄줄이: On the right-hand panel, Figures, Props, Lights, Groups and Pose run down one after another, so the lower blocks get pushed off screen. Click a header and that whole block folds up, letting you keep open only what you are working on — every block in the panel is built the same way, so learn it once and they are all the same. The number next to the title is how many figures are standing in this cut; it stays there even when collapsed, so you know the count without expanding.
해 볼 것: «인물» 머리줄을 눌러 목록을 접었다가, 한 번 더 눌러 펴: Try it: Click the «Figures» header to collapse the list, then click it once more to expand it.
배경 그림이 늘어나면 판이 한없이 길어져 스크롤로는 못 찾습니다. 그래서: As background images pile up, the panel grows endlessly long and scrolling will not find anything. That is why every block has a place to collapse it.
마네킹 줄의 × — 구도에서 지우기: The × on a mannequin row — delete it from the composition
눈 단추는 «이 컷에서 빼기» 라 목록에는 줄이 남지만, 마네킹 줄에만: The eye button means «leave it out of this cut», so the row stays in the list, but the red × that appears only on mannequin rows («Deletes this mannequin») removes the mannequin itself from the composition. It is a temporary figure you stood up here, so it needs a place to be deleted — project figures have no × (they belong to the Characters step and must not be deleted here). If the mannequin you deleted was the selected one, the selection is cleared along with it and the section below closes.
해 볼 것: «+ 남성형» 으로 마네킹을 하나 세운 뒤 그 줄의 × 를: Try it: Stand up a mannequin with «+ Male», then press the × on its row to delete it — Ctrl+Z brings it back.
Ctrl 을 누르고 인물을 여럿 누르면 몸 색을 한 번에 칠하려고 함께: Hold Ctrl and click several figures and they are held together so you can paint their body color all at once; the held rows get a yellow border. If you pick another color while they are still held, people you did not mean to will get colored too, so once you are done painting, empty it with «Release the multi-selection». The row only shows when two or more are held, so if you do not see it, it is already released.
해 볼 것: 인물 둘을 Ctrl 로 잡아 둔 뒤 «함께 잡은 것 풀기»: Try it: Hold two figures with Ctrl, then press «Release the multi-selection».
이름칸 — Enter 확정 · Esc 되돌리기: Name fields — Enter confirms · Esc reverts
The figure name field and the group name field do not take effect while you type. They go in when you press Enter or click once outside the field, and pressing Esc throws away your edit and returns to the original name — so you do not have to reach for Ctrl+Z when you delete something by mistake.
해 볼 것: 이름칸에 아무 글자나 덧붙인 뒤 Esc 를 눌러, 원래 이름: Try it: Add any characters to a name field, then press Esc and see it return to the original name.
한 글자 칠 때마다 반영하면 3D 가 글자마다 다시 그려져 타자가 밀립니: If it applied on every keystroke, the 3D view would redraw for each character and your typing would lag. So it is held back until the moment you confirm.
축 하나만 초기화 · 숫자칸 ↑ ↓: Reset a single axis · ↑ ↓ in number fields
«수치 입력» 아래 위치 · 회전 · 크기 칸은 축 라벨 옆마다 회살표: Under «Numeric input», the Position, Rotation and Size fields each have a revert-arrow button next to the axis label («Reset the X axis only»). The full reset below wipes all three axes, but this one returns just that axis to its default, so you never get «I only touched Z by mistake, but X and Y went too» — an axis already at its default is grayed out and cannot be pressed. With the cursor in a number field, pressing ↑ ↓ steps up and down by a set increment: position 0.1 m · rotation 15° · joints 5° · prop handles 0.05 m.
해 볼 것: 위치 X 칸을 눌러 ↑ 를 두어 번 누른 뒤, 그 축의 회살: Try it: Click the Position X field, press ↑ a couple of times, then put it back with that axis's revert arrow.
다듬기를 한 번 돌리고 나면 «지난 다듬기 — AI/자동 · 키 N개 바: Once you have run smoothing once, a «Last smoothing — AI/auto · N keys changed» row appears. Click it open and you get up to 80 lines showing, for each interval, whether it was «joined» or «left as is», and — if you ran it with AI — the reason it judged that way. This is where you check «why did the arm go soft right there?». If something was joined wrongly, undo the whole thing with Ctrl+Z, change the sensitivity and run it again.
해 볼 것: 자리만 확인하세요. 다듬기를 한 번 돌린 뒤라야 이 줄이 생: Try it: Just check where it is. This row only appears after you have run smoothing once, and «AI analysis smoothing» calls an LLM, so it takes time.
«소품 · 조명» 머리줄과 덩어리 줄: The «Props · Lights» header and group rows
머리줄을 누르면 소품 목록 전체가 접히고, 옆 숫자는 캐릭터 쪽 소품 개: Click the header and the whole prop list folds up; the number beside it is the count of props on the character side — background props that belong to the room are not counted here, they are on the Environment tab. In the list a group stands as a single row, and Ctrl-clicking that row (⌘ on Mac) selects the whole group, so you can mix it with other props and bundle them into one bigger group. The eye at the right of the row «hides the group» — every prop inside it disappears together, and pressing it once more returns it to «show again».
해 볼 것: «소품 · 조명» 머리줄을 눌러 접었다 편 뒤, 덩어리 줄의: Try it: Click the «Props · Lights» header to collapse and expand it, then hide a whole group with the eye on its row.
소품을 묶고 그 덩어리를 고르면 아래에 «덩어리» 묶음이 붙습니다 — 색: Bundle props together and select that group, and a «Group» block appears below — color, name, what to redraw it as, and the group asset all live inside it. Click the header and this card folds up, letting you keep only the prop list above open and long. If no group is selected, this block does not show at all.
해 볼 것: 덩어리를 하나 고른 뒤 «덩어리» 머리줄을 눌러 카드를 접었: Try it: Select a group, then click the «Group» header to collapse and expand the card.
상자 몇 개로 쌓아 둔 덩어리를 그림에서는 「그 물건 하나」 로 그려야: Use this when a group you stacked out of a few boxes has to be drawn in the image as «that one object». Press it and an asset card is created under the group's name and linked straight to this group, and when you generate a sheet from that card, the prompt carries «draw «…» in this spot». If a card is already linked, the button changes to Open «…» — generate sheet and opens that card — it uses the same asset list as «Create an asset for this prop» on individual props.
해 볼 것: 자리만 확인하세요. 누르면 이 작품에 에셋 카드가 하나 새로: Try it: Just check where it is. Pressing it creates one new asset card in this project and opens the card window.
벽 그림의 × — 그림만 떼기: The × on a wall image — remove just the image
«이 벽의 그림» 에 붙여 둔 그림 옆 × 는 «그림만 뗍니다 — 벽은: The × next to the image attached in «Image on this wall» «removes only the image — the wall stays standing». To get rid of the wall itself you use the trash can in the prop list; this × is for stripping off just the attached background when you want to swap in a different image. It shows only while an image is attached, and once you remove it, it changes to «Nothing yet — pick one below, or generate a new one at this size».
해 볼 것: 벽에 그림이 붙어 있으면 × 로 떼어 보세요 — 벽은 그대로: Try it: If a wall has an image attached, remove it with × — the wall stays standing. Undo with Ctrl+Z.
인물을 고르면 판 맨 아래에 «포즈» 묶음이 붙습니다 — 내 프리셋 단추: Select a figure and a «Pose» block appears at the very bottom of the panel — the my-preset buttons, the detailed joint adjustments and the hand shapes are all inside it. Three panels stack up and run long vertically, taking a lot of room, so while you are only positioning figures, click the header to collapse it and use the figure section above with more space.
해 볼 것: 인물을 하나 고른 뒤 «포즈» 머리줄을 눌러 접었다 펴 보세: Try it: Select a figure, then click the «Pose» header to collapse and expand it.
관절 판 머리의 «전체 초기화» 는 그 인물의 관절 각도와 손가락을 모두: «Reset all» at the head of the joint panel clears every joint angle and finger on that figure and returns it to the default pose — use it when you have twisted things around into a tangled pose and want to start over. If no joint has been adjusted it is grayed out and cannot be pressed, and «N adjusted» beside it tells you how many places you have touched so far. Select a single joint and «Reset this joint» sits separately at the right of that field, returning just that joint's three axes to 0 at once while leaving the rest as they are.
Try it: click the «Original» header row to fold it away and open it again.
타일을 누르면 칸이 됩니다: Click a tile and it becomes a panel
Click an image tile once and a new panel appears in an empty spot on the sheet, stepped down from the last one. The panel keeps the pixel size it was generated at — the «2048×2048» written under the tile — and if it is bigger than the sheet it is scaled down at the same ratio and you are told so. An image you place drops out of this list, and it comes back when you remove the panel.
Try it: click one tile to place it on the sheet.
그림을 뽑힌 크기 그대로 넣어야 6000 시트에 몇 장이 들어가는지 가늠: Only when images go in at the size they were generated at can you judge how many will fit on a 6000 sheet. If everything went in at the same size, the way it used to, a 2048 image and a 1024 image would be indistinguishable on the sheet.
6면 세트는 면 하나씩: Six-face sets go in one face at a time
전개도에서 잘린 6면 세트는 낱장 여섯으로 흩어지지 않고 카드 한 장으로: A six-face set cut out of an unfold is not scattered as six separate images; it is folded into a single card. What goes onto the sheet is a single image, so clicking one cell of the card places just that face on the sheet. Drag a cell onto a panel that is already placed and that panel's image is swapped for that face.
해 볼 것: 6면 세트 카드가 있으면 셀 하나를 눌러 시트에 놓아 보세요: Try it: if there is a six-face set card, click one cell and place it on the sheet.
타일의 가위 — 자르기·지우기: The scissors on a tile — crop and erase
타일에 마우스를 올리면 오른쪽 아래에 가위가 뜹니다. 누르면 이 창 위에: Hover over a tile and scissors appear at the bottom right. Click them and the «Crop · Erase» window opens on top of this one, where you can cut out just the face or paint over a stray object in the hand with the surrounding color. What you save becomes a generated image for this character and shows up as a new tile in the list on the left — no need to leave the sheet half-built and come back.
Try it: hover over a tile and find where the scissors sit.
칸의 자리·크기·이름·규격이 «배치도» 이고, 그림이 아니라 틀이라 프로: The positions, sizes and names of the panels plus the output size are what a «Layout» is, and because it is a frame rather than pictures, the whole project shares it. Click the circle to the left of a name to switch to that layout (the panels are replaced wholesale and the undo history of the previous layout is cleared), and edit the name field right where it is. The overlapping squares make a duplicate that inherits the panels, «New layout» starts empty with no panels, and the trash can asks «Delete the layout “…”?» before taking it out of the project list.
Try it: type a name into the layout's name field, something like «Full body, 4 panels».
배치도를 지우면 그것을 쓰던 다른 인물에서도 사라집니다. 이미 구워 둔: Deleting a layout removes it from the other characters that were using it too. Sheet files you have already baked stay as they are.
위 프리셋 셋 말고 «가로»·«세로» 를 직접 쳐서 512~12000 사: Besides the three presets above, you can type «Width» and «Height» yourself and make any size between 512 and 12000 (the ↑↓ keys move in steps of 64). The size is only the canvas, so changing it leaves each panel's px untouched; only panels that ended up outside are pushed back in.
해 볼 것: «가로» 에 4096 을 쳐 보세요. 가로·세로를 오가는 동: Try it: type 4096 into «Width». While you go back and forth between width and height it counts as one action, so a single Ctrl+Z undoes all of it.
「4000」 은 4 → 40 → 400 → 4000 으로 네 번 올라옵니: “4000” arrives in four steps: 4 → 40 → 400 → 4000. Each step is re-fitted from the «state you were in when you started typing», so panels that shrank to fit 512 the moment you typed 4 do not stay that way.
가운데 흰 판이 시트입니다: The white board in the middle is the sheet
6000px 를 그대로 띄울 수 없어 긴 변을 720px 로 줄여 보여: 6000px cannot be shown at full size, so the long edge is scaled down to 720px on screen — if you set a smaller output size, a panel of the same px looks bigger here, and that is correct. Click the white floor rather than a panel and the selected panel is released, and the «Selected panel» block on the left disappears. Drag an image from the left and drop it on empty floor and, unlike clicking, a new panel appears right at that spot.
Try it: click the white floor once to release the selected panel.
칸 옮기기 · 크기 바꾸기 · 그림 갈아 끼우기: Moving a panel · resizing it · swapping its image
상자 전체가 이동 손잡이입니다 — 눌러 고르고 그대로 끌면 자리가 옮겨지: The whole box is the move handle — click to select it and keep dragging to move it, and it never goes outside the sheet. Drag the triangle at the bottom right corner to change the width and height; it only shrinks down to 200px. Drag an image from the left over a placed panel and the border thickens to sky blue; drop it and only the image is swapped while the panel keeps its size (profile text boxes do not accept this).
해 볼 것: 칸 하나를 끌어 옮기고, 오른쪽 아래 모서리를 잡아 크기를: Try it: drag one panel to move it, then grab the bottom right corner and change its size.
의상이 바뀌었을 때 시트를 처음부터 다시 놓지 않으려고 «칸 위에 떨구면: «Drop on a panel to replace» is there so you do not have to lay the sheet out from scratch when an outfit changes. One drag is one undo step, so Ctrl+Z undoes a whole drag at once.
칸 이름표 — 상자 밖 위: The panel's name tag — above the box, outside it
이름표를 한 번 누르면 그 칸이 고른 칸이 되고, 더블클릭하면 그 자리가: Click a name tag once and that panel becomes the selected panel; double-click and the tag turns into an input field. Press Enter or Escape, or click somewhere else, to finish. If you write no name it shows the image's name or «No panel name» · «Empty panel» · «Profile», and the name you write here is the text printed onto the sheet when «Bake panel names» is on.
Try it: double-click a name tag and write «Full body».
이름표가 상자 안에 있으면 그림을 가립니다. 그래서 상자 밖 위에 두고,: A name tag inside the box covers the image. That is why it sits above the box on the outside, and it only moves inside when the panel is flush against the top of the sheet.
칸 왼쪽 아래 X(«빼기»)는 그 칸을 배치도에서 뺍니다 — 그림 파일은: The X at the bottom left of a panel («Remove») takes that panel out of the layout — the image file is untouched, it returns to the «Images to place» list on the left, and Ctrl+Z brings it back. Hover over a panel and scissors appear at the top right: they open the «Crop · Erase» window with that panel's image, and the first of the images you save goes straight into this panel. The rest are kept as generated images for this character.
Try it: hover over a panel and find where «Remove» and the scissors sit.
«고른 칸» — 이름과 크기를 숫자로: «Selected panel» — name and size as numbers
칸을 고르면 왼쪽에 «고른 칸» 블록이 생깁니다. «칸 이름» 은 보드의: Select a panel and the «Selected panel» block appears on the left. «Panel name» is the same value as the name tag on the board, and the «Width» and «Height» under «Size (px)» are where you type in numbers that are hard to hit exactly with the handle (minimum 200px, ↑↓ in steps of 50). A profile text box has no «Panel name» field — «Profile» is printed where the name tag goes.
Try it: select a panel and type 1024 into «Width».
«+ 프로필 글상자» 로 이름·나이·성격·말투를 찍는 칸을 만들면 왼쪽에: Make a panel that prints name, age, personality and speech style with «+ Profile text box» and this block appears on the left. The slider (20~200) and the number field below it change only the text in the profile panel — it moves separately from the box, so widening the box leaves the text as it was. Hover over a profile panel on the board and «A-» and «A+» appear at the top right, shrinking and growing that same value in steps of 4.
해 볼 것: 슬라이더를 끌어 글자를 키워 보세요. 끌기 한 번이 되돌리기: Try it: drag the slider to make the text bigger. One drag is one undo step.
상자를 넓혔더니 글씨까지 같이 커져 배치를 잡을 수 없었습니다. 그래서: Widening the box used to grow the text along with it, which made it impossible to settle the layout. So the two were separated.
«되돌리기»(Ctrl+Z)와 «다시 하기»(화면에는 안 적혀 있지만 Ct: «Undo» (Ctrl+Z) and «Redo» (not written on screen, but Ctrl+Y and Ctrl+Shift+Z do the same) tie a size change together with the panel refitting it caused into one step, undoing and redoing them as a unit. If the orange line «Some panels stick out past the output size. If you bake, those parts will be cut off.» is showing just above, clear it by enlarging the output size or moving those panels back inside, and then bake. Once everything is placed, bake one image with «Make a 6000 × 6000 sheet»; if you came in to fix a sheet that already exists, choose between «Bake again (replaces this sheet)» and «Save as a new version».
해 볼 것: 자리만 확인하세요. 누르면 큰 한 장을 합성해 폴더에 넣느라: Try it: just find where it is. Clicking it takes time, because it composites one big image and puts it in the folder, and the window closes once the bake is done.
«다시 굽기» 는 옛 파일을 지우고 갈아 끼웁니다. «새 판으로 저장»: «Bake again» deletes the old file and puts the new one in its place. «Save as a new version» leaves the old sheet as it is and creates one more entry.
뽑아 온 그림과 영상을 들이는 세 선반 — 낱장 타일과 6면 세트, 업스: The three shelves that take in the images and videos you generated outside — single tiles and six-face sets, upscales, composited sheets, the Magnific inbox and importing, video panels and the large view.
낱장 그림 — 눌러서 크게, Ctrl+C 로 복사: Single images — click to enlarge, Ctrl+C to copy
«생성 결과 이미지» 는 밖(프리픽·컴피UI·마그니픽)에서 뽑아 온 그림: «Generated images» is the shelf where you put the images you generated outside (Freepik, ComfyUI, Magnific). Click a thumbnail and that one image fills the screen — a 120px tile cannot tell you how many fingers there are or whether the eyes went slack, so this is where you check whether an image came out properly. With a tile clicked and selected, press Ctrl+C (Cmd+C on a Mac) and that image goes onto the clipboard, ready to paste straight into an LLM window.
Try it: click one of the single images.
썸네일 네 모서리 — 복사 · 폴더 열기 · 마그니픽으로: The thumbnail's four corners — copy · open folder · send to Magnific
썸네일에 마우스를 올리면 모서리마다 단추가 나타납니다. 왼쪽 위 «복사»: Hover over a thumbnail and a button appears at each corner. Top left, «Copy» puts that image on the clipboard so you can paste it into an LLM window; bottom left, «Open folder» opens the storage folder that holds the file in Explorer with the file selected (it only appears when the file is in the folder). The button at the bottom center pastes that file straight onto the Magnific desktop canvas and tells you in a notification whether it worked. The star at the top center is the cover image, the X at the top right is remove, and the scissors at the bottom right are the editing window.
해 볼 것: 자리만 확인하세요. 아래 가운데를 누르면 마그니픽 데스크톱이: Try it: just find where they are. If you click the bottom center, Magnific desktop receives that image.
The four-corner rule is the same for the reference strip, the generated results and the composited sheets. If even one of them were different, you would have to work out what does what on every image.
크게 보기 창 — 넘기기 · 픽셀 크기 · 닫기: The large view — paging · pixel size · closing
그림을 크게 열면 아래 줄에 이름과 함께 실제 픽셀 크기가 «4096 ×: Open an image large and the bottom line shows its name along with its real pixel size, like «4096 × 4096 (4.0K)» — this is where you check whether the upscale really took, and whether what you believed was 4K really is 4K. If you opened several images, as with a six-face set, page through them with «Previous (←)» and «Next (→)» on either side, and «3 / 6 · ← →» at the bottom updates along with them — the keyboard ← → keys work too. The «Close (Esc)» button, the Esc key, or clicking the black background outside the image all close it.
해 볼 것: «다음 (→)» 으로 한 장 넘기고 «닫기 (Esc)» 로: Try it: page forward one image with «Next (→)», then close it with «Close (Esc)».
6면 세트 카드 — 여섯 면을 한 칸으로: The six-face set card — six faces in one panel
장소의 6면 전개도는 낱장으로 늘어놓지 않고 3×2 카드 하나로 묶입니다: A location's six-face unfold is not laid out as separate images but bundled into a single 3×2 card — six images would fill the shelf and hide everything else. Click the card and all six faces open in the large view starting from the front, and you page through them with ←/→. A set that is not yet complete gets «— N faces missing» after its name and shows «None» in the empty cells. The X at the top right asks «Remove the set — all six face files will be deleted», then takes it out of the list and deletes all six original files in the storage folder as well — there is no way on a set card to remove just one image.
Try it: click a six-face set card.
세트 업스케일 — 여섯 장을 덮어씁니다: Set upscale — overwrites all six images
업스케일 단추는 6면 세트 카드에만 붙습니다 — 낱장 한 장 키우기는 가: The upscale button only appears on six-view set cards — upscaling a single image is gathered under «Upscale and save» in the editor you open with the scissors. Press this button and it enlarges all six views one after another with the «Default» engine and «Default target size» from Settings, **overwriting the same file names** — no copy of the original is kept. While it runs, the card shows how far it has got, like «Upscaling front 1/6», and once it starts you cannot cancel it until it finishes.
해 볼 것: 자리만 확인하세요. 누르면 여섯 장이 차례로 커지며 같은 이: Try it: just find where it is. Pressing it enlarges all six images one after another, overwrites the same names, and cannot be stopped partway.
업스케일 ▾ — 엔진과 목표 크기 고르기: Upscale ▾ — choosing the engine and target size
단추 옆 «▾» 를 누르면 이번 한 번만 쓸 목표 크기와 엔진을 고르는: Pressing the «▾» beside the button opens a menu for choosing a target size and engine to use just this once. In the «Target size» row at the top you pick the long edge you want, such as 2K · 4K; the app actually measures the original's long edge, and when it decides that engine's scale factor cannot reach that far it puts a «*» after the number and tells you «This engine cannot genuinely enlarge it that far — you will get a stretched image». In the «Engine — press to run right away» row below, the installed engines stand with «Default» · «Stretch» · «Experimental» tags, and pressing an engine name is itself the start.
해 볼 것: «업스케일 ▾» 를 눌러 «목표 크기» 만 골라 보세요. 아: Try it: press «Upscale ▾» and pick only a «Target size». The engine row below starts running the moment you press it.
«4K 로 키웠다» 고 믿었는데 사실은 늘리기였던 일이 있어서, 고르기: There was a case where someone believed an image had been «enlarged to 4K» when it had really only been stretched, so now the numbers tell you before you choose.
제작한 시트 — 판마다 이름을 답니다: Sheets you made — name each one
선반 아래 보라색 상자는 모델이 뽑아 준 그림이 아니라 **그것들을 이어: The purple box under the shelf is not an image the model produced — it is a 6000×6000 sheet **we built by stitching those images together**. Press the thumbnail and it fills the screen, so you can check the panels that were invisible at 128px. Write something like «Winter outfit» · «Injured state» in the «Name of this sheet» field below it, and later you will know which of several sheets it is — the file name stays as it is, and only a name for people to call it is added. The tiles carry copy · remove (the original file in the storage folder goes too) · scissors on the same corners as everywhere else — and this sheet is exactly what you need those scissors on to cut panels out.
해 볼 것: 시트 아래 «이 판의 이름» 칸에 «겨울 의상» 처럼 적으세: Try it: write something like «Winter outfit» in the «Name of this sheet» field below the sheet.
화면 위 띠는 마그니픽 동기화 폴더로 내려온 그림·영상을 모아 두는 후보: The strip at the top of the screen is the inbox that collects the images and videos that have come down into the Magnific sync folder. Press the header row and the tiles unfold along with «N items from Magnific — adopt only the ones you will use»; press it again and it folds into a single «Press to unfold» line, leaving only the «In this tab» · «In other tabs: N» counts. «Restore N hidden items» on the right wipes the hide record entirely, putting even images we sent out and got back onto the list again. «Open inbox» opens the project's magnific/ folder in Explorer — a second door to the same place as «Magnific inbox» at the head of the shelf.
Try it: press the inbox header row to unfold it.
후보 타일 — 채택하기 전에 크게 보기: Inbox tiles — view large before adopting
타일 몸통을 누르면 «고른 것» 이 되어 테두리가 보라색으로 바뀌고, 오: Pressing the body of a tile makes it «selected» and turns its border purple; «View large» at the top right fills the screen with that one image without selecting it. At 176px you cannot tell which of cut A · cut B · cut C is better, so this is the stop you make before deciding whose it is. Once you have checked, pick a character · place · cut · scene under «Whose is it?» below the tile to adopt it.
Try it: press «View large» at the top right of an inbox tile.
선반 머리의 «가져오기» 를 누르면 마그니픽 계정에 **이미 만들어 둔*: Pressing «Import» at the head of the shelf opens a window for picking results you have **already made** in your Magnific account — it does not generate anything again, it only pulls over what is there, so it costs nothing extra. Type a word from the prompt you used at the time into the «Search by prompt» field at the top right and only items containing that text are kept (Enter searches right away too). «Search» next to it reloads the list from the beginning. If you are not going to bring anything over, close it with the × on the far right.
Try it: type one word into the «Search by prompt» field.
격자의 타일 하나를 누르면 그 결과를 이 프로젝트 폴더로 내려받아 «인물: Press one tile in the grid and that result is downloaded into this project folder, saved under our own «character_number» name, attached as the card's main image, and the window closes. The tile dims while it downloads, and when it finishes an «Imported from Magnific» notice appears with the saved name. If you are not connected to Magnific, all you see in place of the tiles is «Please press «Connect» in Settings → Magnific».
해 볼 것: 자리만 확인하세요. 타일을 누르면 그 그림을 내려받아 이 카: Try it: just find where it is. Pressing a tile downloads that image, attaches it as this card's main image, and closes the window.
영상 선반 — 재생 · 대표 · 폴더 · 지우기: Video shelf — play · main · folder · delete
밖에서 뽑아 온 mp4 를 «영상 불러오기» 나 끌어다 놓기로 넣으면 칸: Put an mp4 you generated outside the app in with «Load video» or by dragging and dropping, and a player stands in each slot so you can play, pause, seek and adjust the volume right there. The ★ at the top left makes that video the main one for this scene · cut — a yellow border is drawn around it and a ★ is added in front of its name; there is only ever one main video, so pressing another moves it there, and pressing the same one again «removes it as the main video». At the top right are «View full screen» · «Open folder» · «Delete», and delete first asks «The original file in the storage folder will be deleted too. This cannot be undone.»
Try it: press the ★ on a video slot to make it the main one.
큰 화면 — 보면서 바로 대표로: Full screen — set it as main while you watch
선반 칸은 200px 이라 얼굴도 자막도 안 보입니다. «큰 화면으로 보: The shelf slots are 200px, so you can see neither faces nor subtitles. «View full screen» fills the screen with that video and plays it right away, and in the row below you can press «Set as main» · «Remove as main» to decide it on the spot while you are watching anyway. It closes when you press «Close» or the black background outside the video, and pressing the video itself does not close it — the window must not vanish while you are working the scrub bar.
해 볼 것: «닫기» 를 누르거나 영상 바깥의 검은 바탕을 눌러 큰 화면: Try it: close the full screen by pressing «Close» or the black background outside the video.
이미지 편집 — 자르기 · 지우기 · 표시 · 동선: Image editing — crop · erase · markup · motion path
그림 한 장에서 쓸 칸만 잘라 내고, 시키지 않은 물건을 지우고, 자리에: This is the window where you cut out only the panels you will use from a single image, erase objects you never asked for, stamp numbers on spots, draw motion paths, and split a panorama or an unfold into six faces.
가위 — 이 창을 여는 자리: The scissors — where this window opens from
그림 위에 마우스를 올리면 나오는 가위가 이 창을 엽니다. 그림을 밖으로: The scissors that appear when you hover the mouse over an image open this window. It is not a place for exporting the image to fix it elsewhere; it is where you «cut out only the panels you will use · cover up objects you never asked for · stamp numbers on spots · draw arrows» within a single image. Every file that comes out is left in that item's folder under a new name and becomes a reference for the next sheet or an image to upload to a generator.
Try it: hover the mouse over an image and press the scissors.
캐릭터에만 있지 않은 까닭 — 자리를 짚고 화살표를 그리는 일은 배경의: Why it is not only on characters — pointing at spots and drawing arrows is a property of images, not of backgrounds. It is the same window wherever you press it: character · place · asset · cut (rule 1).
탭 다섯 — 무엇을 하는 창인가: Five tabs — what this window is for
«자르기 · 지우기» 는 칸을 잘라 파일로 만들고 시키지 않은 물건을 덮: «Crop · Erase» cuts panels into files and covers up objects you never asked for. «Mark up» points at spots with numbers and shapes, and «Motion path» draws the paths the camera · characters · light move along as arrows. «Panorama» is a tab that only appears on images whose width/height is 1.7 or more; it unrolls a single 360° image and pulls out six faces. «Unfold 6 faces» cuts one cross-shaped unfold into six panels and saves them (this one is always visible, whatever the proportions). In no tab is a single file created until you press «Save».
Try it: press the tabs one by one and see what is in each.
그리기 면 — 자르기냐 지우기냐: The drawing surface — crop or erase
그림 위를 사각형으로 끌면 상자가 하나 생깁니다. 아래 «자르기»(가위): Drag a rectangle over the image and one box appears. With «Crop» (the scissors) below, that box means «a panel that will become a file»; with «Erase» (the eraser) it means «a spot to be covered with the surrounding colour» — the gesture is the same, so check which one you are on before you drag. Cropped images are saved at the original resolution, not the on-screen size, and erasing is applied before cropping, so spots you erased in the same window also show up in the panels you cut out. If there is even one erase box, an «Original»/«Preview» toggle appears at the top right of the surface, so you can keep adjusting boxes while looking at the erased version under «Preview».
Try it: drag over the image to draw one box.
«되돌리기»(Ctrl+Z)는 상자 추가·삭제·덮을 색 바꾸기를 한 칸 되: «Undo» (Ctrl+Z) steps back one notch through adding a box, deleting a box and changing the cover colour, and «Redo» (Ctrl+Shift+Z, and Ctrl+Y does the same) reapplies what you undid. When there is nothing to undo, the button dims. While you are typing in a name field, that field's own undo comes first, so this shortcut steps aside.
Try it: draw one box, then undo it with Ctrl+Z.
이 단축키는 «자르기 · 지우기» 탭에서만 듣습니다. 표시하기 탭에는 그: This shortcut only works in the «Crop · Erase» tab. The Mark up tab has its own separate undo, and while both were live, a single Ctrl+Z made one crop box and one mark disappear together.
저장될 파일 — 이름과 덮을 색: Files to be saved — names and cover colour
오른쪽에 상자마다 한 줄이 섭니다. 자르기 상자는 «이 칸의 이름» 을: On the right, one row stands for each box. A crop box has a field for writing «Name of this panel», and that name becomes both the file name and the Magnific @tag, so using the name from the reference composition as it is makes it easy to find later. An erase box has a «Cover colour» picker instead of a name, and if you leave it alone it averages the colours around the box — to throw away a colour you picked and go back to that method, use «Auto» beside it. The trash can («Delete this spot») removes only that one box, and Ctrl+Z brings it back. «Files to be saved» below shows you in advance what will be created, with what names and sizes (numbers are added when you save).
Try it: write a name for a panel you are going to cut out.
칸을 자르면 그림이 작아지니 키우는 자리가 여기 있습니다. «엔진» 은: Cutting out a panel makes the image smaller, so the place to enlarge it is right here. «Engine» is the field for choosing separately what this window should use instead of the default engine from Settings (only installed ones appear, and experimental engines get « (experimental)» after them), and «2K» «4K» «6K» «8K» are the long edge you are aiming for — sizes the chosen engine cannot genuinely produce get an asterisk, like «4K*», and it tells you «you will get a stretched image». Turn «Upscale and save» on and the saved file is enlarged on the spot and overwrites the same name. If no engine is installed at all, all you get is a note telling you to go to Settings → Upscale engines.
해 볼 것: 자리만 확인하세요. 누르면 이 컴퓨터의 그래픽카드로 몇 분씩: Try it: just find where it is. Pressing it runs for several minutes on this computer's graphics card, and what it overwrites cannot be brought back.
지금 그림 업스케일 — 새 파일로: Upscale the current image — as a new file
위의 «업스케일해서 저장» 과 다른 단추입니다. 자르지도 지우지도 않고: This is a different button from «Upscale and save» above. Without cropping or erasing anything, it enlarges only the image you are currently looking at and creates a new «…_업스케일_NNN» beside the original — the original stays as it is. It can only be pressed on images saved in the folder (an image you merely dragged and dropped is blocked with «Only images saved in the folder can be enlarged»), and while it runs, saving and closing are both locked.
해 볼 것: 자리만 확인하세요. 누르면 엔진이 몇 분 돌고 취소할 수 없: Try it: just find where it is. Pressing it runs the engine for several minutes and cannot be cancelled.
이름이 갈리는 까닭 — 한쪽은 덮어쓰고 한쪽은 새 파일입니다. 둘이 같은: Why the names differ — one overwrites, the other makes a new file. If the two used the same name, you would no longer be able to tell which one is the untouched original.
아래 띠 — 미리보기 새로 고침 · 저장 · 닫기: The bottom strip — refresh preview · save · close
상자를 그리면 미리보기가 저절로 만들어지지만, 기다리지 않고 지금 보고: The preview builds itself when you draw a box, but if you do not want to wait and want to see it now, press «Refresh preview» (while it changes to «Refreshing shortly…» and «Building…», it is baking). If there is an erase box, a «Word to add after 지움 (optional)» field appears on the left, and writing «손» leaves the erased version as «냥이_클로즈업_지움_손_001». On the right, the button that spells out what it will do, such as «Save 3 panels cut · 1 spot erased», is where files are actually created, and «Close» dims while saving or upscaling is running — the × at the top right of the window, ESC and clicking outside are the same door, so while it is running all you get is a «Saving or upscaling is running» notice.
해 볼 것: «미리보기 새로 고침» 을 눌러 결과를 먼저 보세요 — «저: Try it: press «Refresh preview» to see the result first — no file is created until you press «Save».
도는 중에 닫히면 부모가 이 창을 없애 진행 표시가 통째로 사라지고, 몇: If it closes while running, the parent removes this window, the whole progress display disappears, and a job that takes several minutes goes on running off-screen. If you start another upscale from a different window in the meantime, two engines overlap.
표시하기 — 앵커 · 사각형 · 원 · 자유선: Mark up — anchors · rectangles · circles · freehand lines
«BGM에서 고르기» 목록은 이 탭에 들어올 때 한 번 읽습니다 — 칸을: The «Pick from BGM» list is read once when you enter this tab — collapsing and expanding the section does not re-read it. If a track you just generated on the BGM screen doesn't show up here, switch to the «Layout» tab and come back, or close the window and open it again.
«영상에서 모션 가져오기» 칸 — 처음부터 펴짐: The «Import motion from video» section — expanded from the start
이 칸 안에는 단추가 하나뿐입니다 — «영상 올려서 캐릭터에 모션 입히기: There is only one button in this section — «Upload a video and apply its motion to the character». It is the way in for transferring a dancer's movement from a video onto your character, so it has to stand out and we leave it expanded from the start. Click the header row and it collapses to a single line, giving the sections below more room — collapse it once the motion is in and you move on to GLB or video export. The button only opens a window; the analysis, which takes several minutes, is started separately inside that window.
Try it: click the «Import motion from video» header row to collapse it and expand it again.
«GLB 애니메이션» 칸 — 머리줄의 숫자 뱃지: The «GLB animation» section — the number badge on the header row
블렌더에서 만들어 온 움직임을 이 컷에 얹는 칸입니다. 머리줄 제목 옆에: This is where you lay movement made in Blender onto this cut. A round number next to the header title shows how many tracks are currently laid on, and nothing appears when there are none — the number stays visible even when collapsed, so you know whether «something is on here» without expanding. The track cards (clip · start time · playback speed · scale · position · rotation) only appear once the section is expanded, so expand it first to edit what you have laid on.
해 볼 것: «GLB 애니메이션» 머리줄을 눌러 접었다 펴 보세요 — 접: Try it: click the «GLB animation» header row to collapse it and expand it again — the number badge stays on the header row even when collapsed.
축별 초기화 ↺ — 한 축만 0 으로: Per-axis reset ↺ — sets just one axis to 0
GLB 트랙 카드의 «위치» 와 «회전» 은 각각 X · Y · Z 세: «Position» and «Rotation» on a GLB track card each have three fields, X · Y · Z, and a small ↺ sits next to every axis name — six in all («Reset X axis only» · «Reset Y axis only» · «Reset Z axis only»). Click one and only that axis returns to 0; the other two are left alone. An axis that is already 0 is greyed out and cannot be clicked, so a solid ↺ is exactly «an axis I have touched».
해 볼 것: 얹어 둔 GLB 가 있으면 «회전» 의 X 를 조금 바꾼 뒤: Try it: if you have a GLB laid on, change X under «Rotation» a little, then click the ↺ next to it to put it back.
전체 초기화 하나만 두었더니 «Z 만 잘못 건드렸는데 X·Y 까지 날아가: When there was only a single reset-everything button, «I only got Z wrong but X·Y were wiped too» kept happening. And the axes shown here follow the Blender convention — Y is front-back, Z is up-down. This section is for adjusting what came from Blender, so the numbers have to mean the same thing they did there.
이 탭의 숫자칸은 칸 안을 한 번 누른 뒤 위·아래 화살표 키로 정해진: Click once inside a number field on this tab and the up/down arrow keys step it by a set amount — «Start time» 0.1 s · «Playback speed» 0.1 · «Scale» 0.05 · position 0.1m · rotation 15° · «Song offset» 0.5 s. Rotation is 15° because six presses make exactly 90°. Fields with a minimum stop there — «Playback speed» at 0.05, «Scale» at 0.01, and «Start time» and «Song offset» never go below 0. None of this is written on screen.
해 볼 것: 숫자칸 하나를 누르고 ↑ 를 몇 번 눌러 보세요 — «시작: Try it: click one number field and press ↑ a few times — «Start time» or «Song offset» will do.
맨 아래 칸입니다. 펴면 «가로×세로 · N프레임 (24fps · N초): This is the bottom section. Expanded, it holds, in order, the «width×height · N frames (24fps · N s)» summary, the split-render selector row, «● Create reference video (MP4)» and the «Rendered videos» list — the longest section on this tab. Click the header row and the whole thing collapses so you can see the sections above on one screen. Collapsing it mid-render does not stop the work, but it hides the «0 / 0 frames» progress line and «Cancel» along with it, so it is better left expanded while it is running.
해 볼 것: «레퍼런스 영상» 머리줄을 눌러 접었다 펴 보세요. 안의 «: Try it: click the «Reference video» header row to collapse it and expand it again. The «● Create reference video (MP4)» inside runs for several minutes depending on the frame count once you click it — here, just check the header row.
화면 아래 무빙 타임라인의 손끝 — 눈금자와 재생선, 키 점 집기, 고무: The hands-on details of the camera-move timeline at the bottom of the screen — the ruler and the playhead line, grabbing key dots, taking several at once with the rubber band, joint rows, editing move-amount values, per-branch keys on a free path, the floating value panel, the room occlusion squares.
출발: 어느 구도에서 시작하는가: Start: which composition it begins from
머리줄의 «출발: {구도 이름}» 은 이 타임라인의 무빙 전체가 어느 저: «Start: {composition name}» on the header row tells you which saved composition every camera move on this timeline starts from. However much you spin the 3D view around, the starting point does not follow — it has to be written out in text so you never confuse «the view I am looking at now» with «the view the move starts from». Click it and the playhead goes to 0 s so you see that position right away. If you have not saved a single camera, this button does not appear at all — save one first with «Save current composition» on the Camera tab. The «0.00s / 5.0s» on the right is read-only: the first is the playhead time, the second the total length.
Try it: click «Start: …» to send the playhead to 0 s.
계산은 처음부터 맞았는데 화면에 안 보여 「구도 1로 잡은 카메라가 의미: The math was right from the start, but because it was not shown on screen it turned into “so the camera I set as composition 1 means nothing”. A starting point has to be shown in text before you can trust it.
눈금자와 재생선 — 시각을 옮기는 자리는 여기 하나: The ruler and the playhead line — this is the one place you move the time
빨간 세로선과 그 위의 오각형 머리가 «지금 몇 초를 보고 있는가» 입니: The red vertical line and the pentagon head on top of it are «which second you are looking at». This line cannot be touched — we made it undraggable. To move the time, click the ruler above it, or press and drag left and right (scrubbing). If the line could be dragged, it would pass over tightly packed keys and grab the wrong one. During playback only this line moves and the rest of the screen stays as it is — redrawing the screen every frame would rebuild the whole 3D scene. To land exactly on a key, use the previous · next keyframe buttons on the header row instead of the ruler (matching it by hand lands 0.05 s off and creates a new key).
해 볼 것: 눈금자를 누른 채 좌우로 끌어 보세요. 빨간 선과 3D 화면: Try it: press the ruler and drag it left and right. The red line and the 3D view follow along together.
클립이 하나도 없으면 목록 자리에 «아직 무빙이 없습니다 — 카메라는 고: When there is not a single clip, the list area shows «No camera moves yet — the camera is fixed». The «Add a move» and «Camera tab» written after it are old names that are no longer on screen, so do not go looking for them — moves are added from the row of move icons just above (dolly · orbit · pan · tilt · truck · crane · zoom · free path), and clicking one icon creates a clip as a new row. Even with no clip you can still set character · prop · room keys separately — that gives you a cut where only the camera stays still.
해 볼 것: 무빙 아이콘 줄에서 아이콘 하나를 눌러 클립을 한 줄 세워: Try it: click one icon in the row of move icons to stand up a clip as a new row.
키 점 — 마름모 하나가 «그 시각의 값»: Key dots — one diamond is «the value at that moment»
인물 · 소품 줄의 작은 마름모가 키 하나입니다 — «이 시각에 이 값이: Each small diamond on a character · prop row is one key — a nail driven in to say «at this time it was this value», and the app joins the nails up in between. Drag it and that key's time moves; click it once and it is selected and turns white, and Delete removes it. Keys shown in orange are the ones held by the «rubber band» of the next step. The visible dot is tiny, but the clickable area laid under it is wider, so even the dense keys that come in from motion capture are grabbed as long as you click near the dot (if it still will not grab, stretch things out sideways with the zoom «+»). Hover the mouse over one and «who · which channel · how many seconds» appears.
해 볼 것: 키 점 하나를 눌러 고른 뒤 좌우로 살짝 끌어 보세요. Ct: Try it: click one key dot to select it, then drag it slightly left or right. Ctrl+Z brings it back.
고무줄 — 빈 자리를 끌어 여러 키를 한꺼번에: Rubber band — drag on empty space to take several keys at once
키 줄의 빈 자리를 누른 채 옆으로 끌면 노란 띠가 생기고, 그 구간에: Press on empty space in a key row and drag sideways and a yellow band appears, taking every key that falls inside that span. Whichever row you dragged in, it takes the keys of every character and every channel together — that matters, because one movement needs position · rotation · pose to move together, and a dance performed by two people has to be pushed for both at once. Drag one of the held keys and the whole group follows («push the whole intro back by 1 second» is exactly this). If the drag is very narrow — that is, effectively just a tap — everything held is released.
해 볼 것: 키 줄의 빈 자리를 누른 채 옆으로 끌어 키 여러 개를 잡아: Try it: press on empty space in a key row and drag sideways to take several keys.
«키 N개 잡음 · 풀기» 와 «끝 뒤 N개»: «N keys held · release» and «N past the end»
«키 N개 잡음 · 풀기» 는 고무줄로 몇 개를 잡아 두었는지 세어 보여: «N keys held · release» counts how many the rubber band is holding, and clicking it releases them all (a tap on empty space in a key row releases them too). Dragging one key while you have forgotten what is held makes the whole group follow and takes you by surprise, so the count is always kept. Right next to it, «N past the end» is the number of keys pushed beyond the total length and hidden from view — they are not deleted. Shorten the length to 5 s and a key at 7 s is merely invisible, still there, and it returns to its place when you lengthen it again.
해 볼 것: 키를 몇 개 잡은 뒤 «키 N개 잡음 · 풀기» 를 눌러 풀: Try it: take a few keys, then click «N keys held · release» to release them.
길이를 줄였다가 「키가 지워졌다」 고 읽는 일이 있었습니다. 세어 주면: Someone shortened the length and read it as “the keys were deleted”. Counting them out removes the misunderstanding.
관절 줄 — 이름을 누르면 그 관절이 잡힙니다: Joint rows — click the name and that joint is selected
인물 레이어의 «▸ 자세» 를 펴면 움직인 관절마다 «· 왼팔» «· 머: Expand «▸ Pose» on a character layer and a name row stands up for every joint that moved, like «· Left arm» or «· Head». Click the name and that joint on that character is selected, and a gizmo (red · green · blue rings) appears in the 3D view — you fix the angle right there, without leaving the timeline and without hopping to the Layout tab to reopen the pie menu. The selected row lights up green. Hover the mouse over the name and that joint's keys list out in the form «1.20 s 12°·0°·−30°», so a glance at the numbers alone shows which key jumped — the fastest way to touch up keys that came in from motion capture.
해 볼 것: «▸ 자세» 를 펴고 관절 이름 하나를 눌러 3D 화면에 기: Try it: expand «▸ Pose», click one joint name and see the gizmo appear in the 3D view.
이동량 키의 값 고치기: Editing the value of a move-amount key
프리셋 클립(달리 · 오빗 · 팬 …)의 «이동량» 은 클립 전체가 «지: The «move amount» of a preset clip (dolly · orbit · pan …) is how far the whole clip travels «from the current pose», while the small keys inside the clip say «this far at that moment». Click a key dot once and «1.20 s» and a number field open on the handle row, editing only the move amount at that spot — it sits right beside the clip's overall move amount, so you can set it while seeing «this clip goes to −2.5, but at 1.2 s it is −1». Double-click the dot and a «Move amount at 1.20 s» input window appears, taking the number along with a note on what this move's unit is (degrees · multiplier · metres). If you have no reason to bend the speed partway through, the clip's single move amount is enough without any keys.
해 볼 것: 클립 안의 이동량 키 점을 두 번 눌러 값 입력 창을 열어: Try it: double-click a move-amount key dot inside a clip to open the value input window.
자유 경로 — 갈래마다 따로 찍는 키와 값 판: Free path — keys set per branch, and the value panel
«자유 경로» 클립은 아래에 «↳ 이동» «↳ 바라보는 곳» «↳ 줌»: A «Free path» clip puts out three separate rows beneath it: «↳ Move», «↳ Look at» and «↳ Zoom». The «+» at the end of a row sets a key for that branch alone at the playhead — unlike the «+ All keys» above, which sets position · look direction · zoom all at once. That is what makes «leave the camera still and pull the zoom in slowly» possible. Click a key and a «Free path · key at N s» value panel appears over the timeline, taking «Camera position (m)» and «Look at (m)» as numbers — rotation is written as a «point being looked at» rather than an angle because many angles produce the same picture, which makes matching by hand very hard (if the character's feet are at (0,0,0), just write those values in). Once you are done editing, dismiss it with «Close» (X) at the top right of the panel so the key rows below are visible again.
해 볼 것: 자유 경로 클립의 «↳ 줌» 줄에서 «+» 를 눌러 줌 키만: Try it: click the «+» on the «↳ Zoom» row of a free path clip to set just one zoom key.
속도 그래프 판 — 속도 · 진행률 · 닫기: The speed graph panel — speed · progress · close
«속도 그래프» 를 누르면 타임라인 위에 겹쳐 작은 판이 뜹니다(타임라인: Click «Speed graph» and a small panel appears over the timeline (fit it inside the timeline instead and the panel grows by the height of the graph and pushes the Composition Planner heading up). «Speed» and «Progress» at the top left of the panel are only a switch between two pictures of the same curve; edit from either side and what you edit is one and the same — «Speed» is a parabola drawn from the slope, for reading «where it speeds up and where it stops», while «Progress» is an S curve rising from 0 to 1, for reading «how far it has gone so far». If one of them does not click for you, flip over to the other. When you are done looking, dismiss it with «Close» (X) at the top right so the key rows it covered are visible again.
해 볼 것: «속도 그래프» 를 열고 «속도» 와 «진행률» 을 번갈아: Try it: open the «Speed graph» and click «Speed» and «Progress» in turn to compare how the same curve looks different.
«방 · 가릴 면 · 소품» 묶음의 키만 마름모가 아니라 네모입니다. 꽉: Only the keys in the «Room · occluding faces · props» group are squares rather than diamonds. A filled square is «Occlude» («See-through» on a prop row) and an empty square is «Do not occlude» («Block») — colour alone was not enough to tell them apart, so we made the shape different. Squares drag to move their time in just the same way, and you select one by clicking and delete it with Delete. In a cut where the camera passes through a wall, this one row writes «the front wall occludes up to 3 s and opens after that». If you expand a horizon room and only «↳ No props» appears, it is not empty — a horizon simply has no faces to occlude with. Stand a product up with «Props in this room» on the Environment tab and its see-through row appears here.
해 볼 것: 방 줄의 «가림 / 열림» 을 눌러 키를 하나 찍고, 생긴: Try it: click «Occlude / Open» on the room row to set one key, then drag the square that appears left and right.
해 볼 것: 관절 하나를 골라 각도를 바꿔 본 뒤 «이 관절 초기화» 로: Try it: Pick a joint, change its angle, then bring it back with «Reset this joint».
파이 메뉴에서 빠져나오기 — 한가운데 점 · 바깥 누르기: Getting out of the pie menu — the center dot · clicking outside
Tab 으로 연 관절 고르기 메뉴는 고리를 따라 상체 · 왼쪽 · 오른쪽: The joint-picker menu you open with Tab drills inward through its rings — upper body · left · right · fingers. Clicking the center dot means «one step back», or «close» if you are on the first ring — the same thing Ctrl+Tab does on the keyboard, done with the mouse. Clicking empty space outside the menu closes it outright, so when you open it by mistake you can get out without moving your hand to the keyboard.
해 볼 것: 인물을 고른 채 Tab 으로 메뉴를 연 뒤, 바깥 빈 자리를: Try it: With a character selected, open the menu with Tab, then click empty space outside it to close it.
Esc 는 구도잡기 창을 닫는 키라 여기서는 안 씁니다 — 첫 고리에서: Esc is the key that closes the Composition Planner window, so it is not used here — someone pressed it once more on the first ring and the whole window closed.
손 프리셋은 한쪽 손만 맞춰 저장합니다. «손 프리셋 적용 대상» 의 «: A hand preset is posed and saved for one hand only. «Left hand» · «Right hand» under «Apply hand preset to» decides which hand the preset you click goes onto, and if it is the opposite of the hand it was saved for, it goes in mirrored — that is how one preset serves both hands. If you press «+ Save current pose», start typing a name and group, and then change your mind, use «Cancel»: it throws away what you typed and closes only the save panel (the character's pose is left alone).
해 볼 것: «손 프리셋 적용 대상» 에서 «오른손» 을 눌러 대상을 바: Try it: Under «Apply hand preset to», click «Right hand» to switch the target.
환경 탭 구석구석: Every corner of the Environment tab
planner.ts 의 기존 «방과 환경»(planner-rooms) 은: The existing «Rooms and environment» (planner-rooms) in planner.ts is already 11 steps, so adding 14 more would push it past 16. So we branch off a new one that follows it, planner-env (kind "planner", page "planner", 12 steps) — number-field key control · cyclorama
접히는 칸과 안 접히는 칸: Sections that collapse and sections that don't
«방» 머리줄 왼쪽에 화살표가 있지만 늘 아래를 가리키고, 눌러도 접히지: There is an arrow at the left of the «Room» header, but it always points down and clicking it collapses nothing — with no room there is nothing to do on this tab, so it stays open at all times. «View» at the very bottom is the same. The only header on this tab that really collapses is «Room library». What unfolds below a room when you click it (dimensions · the face that blocks the back · 6-face set · panorama images · props in this room) is not a section but properties attached to that room's row, so clicking another room opens that one and closes this one.
해 볼 것: «방» 머리줄을 한 번 눌러 보세요 — 안 접히는 것이 맞습: Try it: Click the «Room» header once — it is supposed to not collapse. The «Room library» header below it does collapse.
방 목록을 접을 수 있게 두었더니 «방이 없는 컷» 과 «접어 둔 컷»: When the room list could be collapsed, a «cut with no room» and a «cut with the list collapsed» looked identical on screen. A new cut has no room by default, so those two have to be told apart.
구도잡기의 숫자 칸은 치수든 자리든 전부 같은 입력칸입니다. 칸을 누르고: Every number field in the Composition Planner is the same kind of input, whether it is a dimension or a position. Click into a field and ↑ raises it one step, ↓ lowers it — there is no handle to drag with the mouse, so this key is the fastest way to dial in «just a little more». The step differs per field: a room's width · depth · ceiling height step by 0.1 m, the dome's radius by 0.5 m, rotation by 15°. Room dimensions will not go below 0.4 m and prop size will not go below 0.1 — hold the key down and it stops there. You can also just type decimals and negative numbers (a half-typed «-» on its own will not snap back to 0).
해 볼 것: «가로 (m)» 칸을 누르고 ↑ 를 세 번 눌러 방을 0.3: Try it: Click the «Width (m)» field and press ↑ three times to widen the room by 0.3 m.
호리존 방에는 색 칩이 여섯 있습니다 — «흰색» · «밝은 회색» ·: A cyclorama room has six color chips — «White» · «Light gray» · «18% gray» · «Black» · «Chroma green» · «Chroma blue». The default for product cuts is not pure white but «Light gray» (pure white blows out and the edges of the product get swallowed by the background). «18% gray» is the mid gray used as a reference for metering exposure, and the two chroma colors are for compositing, when you plan to swap the background out later. One click of a chip paints all six faces that color and becomes one undo step. The chip matching the current color gets a blue outline, so you can see «what color it is right now». If you need a color outside the six, click the «#f2f2f2» chip at the top right and pick one with the color picker.
해 볼 것: 호리존 방이 있으면 «18% 회색» 을 눌러 보고 Ctrl+: Try it: If you have a cyclorama room, click «18% gray» and then undo it with Ctrl+Z.
색 고르개는 끄는 동안 눈금마다 색이 바뀝니다. 그걸 그대로 되돌리기에: While you drag in the color picker, the color changes at every increment. If all of that were pushed onto the undo stack, one color pick would flush out everything recorded before it, so it is recorded just once, the moment the picker opens — drag around in the picker as long as you like and a single Ctrl+Z gets you back to the color from before you opened it.
덩어리 줄 — 함께 숨기기 · 덩어리 에셋: Group rows — hiding together · group assets
소품 여럿을 묶으면 «이 방의 소품» 목록에 색 사각형과 «N개» 가 붙: Group several props together and a single group row, with a colored square and «N items», appears in the «Props in this room» list. The eye on that row hides **all** the props in the group at once and shows them again together — you do not have to switch off four chairs one by one, and you never end up with just one left visible. Select a group and «Create an asset for this group — generates a sheet and links it right away» appears below. Click it and an asset card is created under the group's own name and linked to this group; if a card is already linked, it becomes «Open «Dining set» — generate a sheet» and opens that card in the background asset window. Only when an asset is linked to the group does the prompt carry «Dining set» as one thing instead of four chairs.
해 볼 것: 덩어리가 있으면 줄의 눈을 눌러 통째로 숨겼다가 다시 보이게: Try it: If you have a group, click the eye on its row to hide the whole thing, then show it again.
고른 소품의 «위치» · «회전» · «크기» 는 각각 세 칸입니다(크기: A selected prop's «Position» · «Rotation» · «Size» each have three fields (the size fields are named width · height · depth, not X·Y·Z). Next to each field name there is a very small ↺ that returns **just that one** axis to its default — 0 for position and rotation, 1 for size. The ↺ of an axis already at its default is dimmed and inactive, so a glance at the lit ones shows you «which axes I touched». There is no button that resets all three axes at once — press ↺ three times, or go back with Ctrl+Z.
해 볼 것: 소품을 하나 고르고 «회전» 의 Z 를 바꾼 뒤 그 옆 ↺: Try it: Select a prop, change Z under «Rotation», then press the ↺ beside it to reset just that axis.
The axes are kept separate because «I only messed up the height» happens far more often. Resetting all three at once would also wipe out the other two you worked to get right.
소품 색 — 열두 칩과 직접 고르기: Prop color — twelve chips and picking your own
