색은 3D 화면에서 어느 상자가 무엇인지 가리는 표시이면서, 그대로 프롬: Color is both the marker that tells you which box is what in the 3D view and, word for word, what goes into the prompt (the composition capture carries no name labels, so «that box is the sofa» has to be said with color). There are twelve chips — gray · red · orange · yellow · green · teal · blue · purple · pink · brown · white · black — and the small swatch at the far end («Pick prop color yourself») lets you choose a color outside them too. The prompt, however, does not carry «#e2534f»; it is translated into **the name of the nearest of the twelve colors** — a generator can find a «red box» in a picture, but not a hex value. A single line under the fields shows the sentence exactly as it will go in, like «red box = bag».
해 볼 것: 소품을 고르고 «소품 색 직접 고르기» 로 아무 색이나 찍어: Try it: Select a prop and pick any color with «Pick prop color yourself» — the color name in the sentence below changes to one of the twelve.
«6면 세트» 옆 «그림 전체보기» 를 누르면 화면을 덮는 «배경 라이브: Click «View all images» next to «6-face set» and the «Background library» opens over the whole screen. This is where you browse, at a large size, the sets you could not make out in the small box on the right panel, and click one to apply it to this room as a whole. «Search by name...» in the header filters set names and the unfold originals below them **together** — type «cafe» and both «Cafe 6-face set» and «Cafe unfold» remain. When you are done, the X («Close») just right of the search field lifts the cover and takes you back to the Environment tab. Clicking a set applies it to the room and closes by itself, so the X is for «leaving without applying anything».
해 볼 것: «그림 전체보기» 를 열고 검색 칸에 방 이름 한 글자를 쳐: Try it: Open «View all images» and type one character of a room name into the search field.
배경 라이브러리를 아래로 굴리면 두 번째 묶음이 나옵니다. 여기 있는 것: Scroll the background library down and a second group appears. What is here is the single-sheet original from **before** it was cut into six faces, so clicking it does nothing — that is deliberate. What goes onto the room is the six cut faces; the originals are here so you can check by eye «what this set came from». The header lists the two counts separately as «N sets · N unfold originals», so this is also where you count whether any unfold you generated has not been cut yet.
해 볼 것: 아래 «전개도 원본 · 배경 그림» 줄까지 굴려 내려, 세트: Try it: Scroll down to the «Unfold originals · background images» row below and compare which single image a set was cut from.
예전에는 이 창이 낱장 목록이라 고른 그림이 «지금 면»(정면) 한 장에: This window used to be a list of single images, and the image you chose was applied only to the «current face» (the front). Showing a set but applying only one face is the screen telling a lie, so the list you apply from was changed to sets, and the originals were split off into a view-only area.
다른 작품에서 방 끌어오기: Pull rooms in from another project
«방 라이브러리» 목록은 이 작품 것만 담습니다 — 작품이 쌓일수록 목록: The «Room library» list holds only this project's rooms — it is split that way so the list does not grow endlessly as projects pile up. So rooms saved in another project are brought in as **copies** with «Pull rooms in from another project». The window lists one row per room — «name · which project · N props · N faces applied» — and clicking a row turns on the ✓ at its left. Turn on several, press «Import» once, and they are all copied at once; «Close» leaves without importing anything. Once imported they have no connection to the original project, so editing or deleting them here leaves that side untouched. Only the face images that are actually applied come along; faces with nothing applied do not.
해 볼 것: «다른 작품에서 방 끌어오기» 를 열어 목록만 보고 «닫기»: Try it: Open «Pull rooms in from another project», just look at the list, and leave with «Close». If there are no saved rooms, «There are no rooms to pull in» appears.
«라이브러리에서 지우기» — 목록에서만: «Remove from library» — from the list only
방 라이브러리 줄 오른쪽 끝의 작은 X 입니다. 이름 그대로 목록에서 그: This is the small X at the right end of a room library row. As the name says, it is the button that removes only that saved copy from the list; it touches neither the room you have already built nor the image files applied to it — there is nothing to lose, so it disappears immediately without asking. Do not confuse it with the other deletes on this tab: the × on «Panorama images» below deletes the original in the folder as well, and the trash can in the place-card window deletes the card from the project. Even if you remove one by mistake, pressing «Save current room — room + the props inside» once more in the cut where that room is built puts it back in the list.
해 볼 것: 자리만 확인하세요. 누르면 묻지 않고 그 저장본이 목록에서: Try it: Just find where it is. Clicking it makes that saved copy vanish from the list without asking — the room you built and its images stay as they are.
파노라마 카드의 × — 폴더의 원본까지: The × on a panorama card — the original in the folder too
실외 방의 «파노라마 그림» 목록에서 카드 오른쪽 위에 겹쳐 있는 작은: This is the small × overlaid on the top right of a card in an outdoor room's «Panorama images» list (using another row would have halved the card size, so it sits on top of the image). It is **not** a button that removes it from the list — it asks once, «The original file in the save folder will be deleted as well. This cannot be undone», and if you say yes it deletes that image file itself from the project folder. If all you meant to do was detach the dome currently applied, that is «Release dome» above, not the ×. To fill the list again, generate one with «Create panorama» or drag a 360° image onto this spot.
해 볼 것: 자리만 확인하세요. 누르면 확인 창이 뜨고, 예라고 하면 저: Try it: Just find where it is. Clicking it opens a confirmation, and saying yes deletes the original image in the save folder as well.
목록에서만 빼면 폴더를 다시 읽을 때 그 그림이 되살아나 «지웠는데 또: If it were only removed from the list, the image would come back the next time the folder is read and you would get «I deleted this and here it is again». So this app is unified on «deleting it from the screen deletes the original in the folder too», and here alone Ctrl+Z is of no use — the file is already gone.
«전개도 만들기»(실외는 «파노라마 만들기») 나 «열기» 로 뜨는 장소: In the place-card window that opens from «Create unfold» (outdoors, «Create panorama») or «Open», this is the red trash can to the right of the name field. The X at the far right of the window only closes the window, so do not mix them up — that is why the space between the two was deliberately left empty. Pressing the trash can deletes this place card from the project and closes the window with it, and if that card was linked to the current room, the room's «Place» link is cut as well and goes back to empty (a wall-image card has nothing to do with the room, so its link is left alone). What disappears is the card and the prompts and analysis inside it; the image files in the folder remain, but it deletes without asking and the Composition Planner's Ctrl+Z will not bring it back — Ctrl+Z only undoes the composition (room · characters · props). If you only mean to detach it from the room, do not delete the card; use the × next to the place dropdown on the Environment tab.
해 볼 것: 자리만 확인하세요. 누르면 묻지 않고 장소 카드가 사라지고: Try it: Just find where it is. Clicking it makes the place card disappear without asking and closes the window.
타임라인 탭 훑어보기: A walk through the Timeline tab
구도잡기 오른쪽 «타임라인» 탭 자체를 다루는 새 튜토리얼 7걸음을 pl: A proposal to add a new 7-step tutorial to planner.ts covering the «Timeline» tab on the right of the Composition Planner itself (id: planner-timeline-tab, placed after TIMELINE in PLANNER_TUTORIALS). The four sections («Song» · «Import motion from video» · «GLB ani
오른쪽 패널의 «타임라인» 을 누르면 칸이 넷 세로로 섭니다 — 위에서부: Click «Timeline» on the right panel and four sections stack vertically — from the top, «Song» · «Import motion from video» · «GLB animation» · «Reference video». All four deal with «how this cut flows over time». Time itself (total length · fps · playback · keys) is not on this tab but in the timeline at the bottom of the screen; the sections here decide what you lay on that clock (song · motion · GLB) and what you pull out of it (reference video). The window always opens on the «Layout» tab, so you have to click once to get into this one.
Try it: Click «Timeline» at the top of the right panel.
칸 머리줄 왼쪽의 ▸ 와 ▾ 가 접기·펴기입니다. 네 칸 중 «노래» 만: The ▸ and ▾ at the left of a section header collapse and expand it. Of the four sections, only «Song» starts collapsed — for a cut that is not a music video you do not lay a song under it. Click the header and it expands to show «Choose from BGM — songs you've generated» and «Upload audio». The header stays even when collapsed, so you can expand it again at any time. The collapsed/expanded state is remembered by this cut's Composition Planner and survives closing and reopening the window; restart the app and it goes back to the default (only «Song» collapsed).
Try it: Click the «Song» header to expand it.
Try it: pick a shape and drag on the image to place a marker.
Try it: type something like «Anchor A» in the name field.
동선 — 카메라 · 인물 · 빛이 움직이는 길: Motion paths — the routes the camera, the characters and the light travel
그림 위에 화살표 달린 선을 그어 영상 생성기에 «무엇이 어디로 움직이는: This is the tab where you draw arrowed lines on the image to nail down for the video generator «what moves where». On the left, pick a type — «camera path» (purple dashed) · «character path» (blue solid) · «light path» (thin triple line) — and with the three buttons beside it choose «view only» (so you don't draw a line by accident) · «freehand» (exactly where you drag) · «straight» (start point and end point only). «Thickness» (0.3–2) applies only to lines you draw from now on, so set it before you draw — lines already drawn don't change. The undo button («erases only the last line») and Ctrl+Z remove the line you just drew, and «Save motion path image» bakes the lines into the original resolution and leaves the file as «original name_motion path» in this item's folder.
해 볼 것: 갈래와 도구를 고르고 그림 위를 끌어 선을 하나 그어 보세요: Try it: pick a type and a tool, then drag on the image to draw one line.
파노라마 탭 — 먼저 «사용 방법 보기»: Panorama tab — start with «Show how to use»
가로/세로가 1.7 이상인 그림에서만 뜨는 탭입니다. 360° 로 뽑은: This tab appears only for images whose width/height is 1.7 or more. It is where you unroll a single 360° render into an equirectangular (2:1) image and cut six images out of it — front·back·left·right·up·down — and the room and dome in the Composition Planner use those six faces as they are. Press «Show how to use» on the right and the five steps for making a 6-face background unfold (which chip to render with · what to feed in as a reference · where to hang it), and «Collapse» folds them away — whether it is open or closed is remembered on this computer only.
Try it: press «Show how to use» and read through the five steps.
펴기 — 세로 화각 · 지평선 · 이음매: Unrolling — vertical field of view · horizon · seam
여기 손잡이들은 그림을 꾸미는 칸이 아니라 «원본이 무엇을 담고 있는지»: The controls here are not fields for dressing up the image; they are fields that tell the app «what the original contains». «Already an equirectangular panorama (180° vertical — untouched)» is on by default, and while it is on, «Vertical field of view» and «Horizon position» stay locked. For an image that is flat like 4:1 or has no top-and-bottom distortion, switch «Vertical model» to «Cylindrical» (the lock releases and a field of view is estimated from the aspect ratio). For something «equirectangular but not 180°», such as a 21:9 equirectangular, press «Equirectangular» just to release the lock and lower «Vertical field of view» to about 154 — that is the only way to produce that value. «Horizon position» is the height at which the horizon sits in the original (if it is off, all six faces tilt), «Seam blending» is the width over which the left and right edges are blended to erase the wrap-around mark, and «Fill sky · floor» («Fill ceiling · floor» for an interior background) stretches the edge color over the top and bottom poles that the original doesn't contain.
Try it: drag «Horizon position» until the dashed line sits right on the horizon.
위 면과 바닥 두 장만 보면 맞았는지 압니다 — 하늘이 위쪽 면에 안 담: The top and bottom faces alone tell you whether it is right — if the sky isn't contained in the top face and is pushed up onto the side faces, the vertical field of view is too small; if the top face becomes nothing but a flat cap of color, it is too large.
여섯 면 만들기 · 보정한 파노라마 저장: Make six faces · Save the corrected panorama
«보정한 파노라마 저장» 은 지금 손잡이대로 편 등장방형 한 장을 «…_: «Save corrected panorama» puts the equirectangular image, unrolled exactly as the current controls have it, into the «panorama» folder under its own name «…_panorama», and «Make six faces» cuts six images from it and saves them as one set in the «6 faces» folder so they hook straight into «6-face set» on the Composition Planner's environment tab. «Six-face size» above is the length of one side of a face (1024 · 2048 · 4K · 6K · 8K), and the line below it compares that with «the original resolution of one face of this panorama» and tells you whether it is «just stretching» or «upscaling with the engine». If an engine is installed, an «Upscale if smaller (engine name)» checkbox appears, and with it on each face really is enlarged, with progress shown like «Upscaling front 1/6».
해 볼 것: 자리만 확인하세요. 누르면 여섯 장을 굽고, 업스케일을 켜: Try it: just note where it is. Pressing it bakes six images, and if upscaling is on it runs for several minutes, during which you can't close the window.
전개도 6면 — 자르는 선 맞추기: Unfold 6 faces — aligning the cut lines
십자 전개도 한 장을 여섯 칸으로 직접 자르는 탭입니다. 층고가 낮은 실: This is the tab where you cut a cross-shaped unfold into six cells by hand. An interior cross with a low ceiling comes out around 16:9 and so never reaches the panorama tab, which is why this tab is always visible regardless of aspect ratio. When you open it, it measures the gray background and finds the boundaries automatically; if they are off, drag the three purple vertical lines and four sky-blue horizontal lines into place — a line can't cross its neighbor, and while you drag, the magnifier follows that spot. Click a line once to select it (yellow) and the arrow keys move it by 1 px of the original, or 10 px with Shift — that is how you land on a single row you can't grab at screen pixel size.
Try it: click a line to select it, then move it 1 px at a time with the arrow keys.
잡는 띠는 10 px 이고 그 한가운데가 실제 자르는 자리입니다. 예전에: The grab band is 10 px wide and its center is the actual cut position. The horizontal lines used to be drawn 5 px too high, which made the magnifier and the full view look different — the cut value was right from the start; only the drawing was wrong.
확대 · 돋보기 · 여섯 면으로 저장: Zoom · magnifier · save as six faces
오른쪽 칸이 «맞았는지 보는» 도구입니다. «축소» «확대» 는 1.5배: The panel on the right is the tool for «seeing whether it lines up». «Zoom out» and «Zoom in» step by 1.5× (Ctrl+wheel over the image board) between 100% and 800%, and the «100%» in the middle returns to the fit-to-window size. Below it, the magnifier shows the 48 px of the original around the cursor at 8× so you can see whether a line is off by even one row, and «Find positions again» re-measures the gray background and returns hand-moved lines to their initial state. Leave «Flip ceiling · floor» on — on an unfold, the «front side» is the bottom edge of the ceiling cell, but when it is applied to the box it has to be the top edge (turn it off if the generator drew it the other way round). «Save as six faces» cuts the six cells at the original resolution and puts them as one set into the owner folder's «6 faces»; if all six can't be cut, it saves nothing and stops you with a notice.
해 볼 것: «확대» 로 키워 선이 맞는지 보세요. «여섯 면으로 저장»: Try it: zoom in with «Zoom in» and check that the lines line up. For «Save as six faces», just note where it is — pressing it creates six images in the folder as one set.
왼쪽 «영상 N개» 목록의 한 줄이 올린 영상 하나입니다. 줄 아래 작은: Each row in the «N videos» list on the left is one uploaded video. The small text under a row is that video's state — before analysis «MediaPipe · built into the app · not analyzed», while it runs «Analyzing…», and once it finishes «N people · pairs N · from 0.00 s». Click a row (Enter does the same when the row has focus) and the preview in the middle and «1 · Analyze» «2 · Clean up» «3 · Number ↔ character» on the right all switch over to that video — model · range · frames per second · mirror · pairing all live per video, so before you change a value, first look at «which row is active». Double-click to rename (this name is what shows on the timeline layer), and the trash can means «remove from the list — the original video file stays».
해 볼 것: 영상을 둘 올린 뒤 두 줄을 번갈아 누르며, 오른쪽 세 단이: Try it: upload two videos, click the two rows in turn, and watch the three sections on the right hold different values for each row.
군무 한 편과 솔로 여러 편을 섞어 쓰는 것이 이 창의 본래 쓰임이라,: Mixing one group-dance video with several solo ones is what this window is really for, so the settings live per video rather than across the whole window.
미리보기 — «재생 / 멈춤» 과 재생 위치 막대: Preview — «Play / Pause» and the playhead bar
가운데는 고른 영상의 미리보기입니다. «재생 / 멈춤» 은 이 영상만 돌: The middle is the preview of the selected video. «Play / Pause» runs only this video (there is no sound). If the video has been analyzed, the skeleton and number of each person found in every frame are drawn over the video — this is where you check with your own eyes «who number 2 is» and «whether the skeleton tracks the person properly». The long unlabeled bar below it is the playhead: drag it and it jumps to that spot in steps of 0.01 s, and the overlaid skeleton follows even while paused. The «0.00 / 12.3 s» on the right is the current position and the total length, so you can type the seconds you read here straight into the «Range» field on the right. With mirror video on, the preview is flipped left-right as well.
해 볼 것: 분석이 끝난 영상에서 막대를 천천히 끌어, 뼈대가 사람에게서: Try it: on an analyzed video, drag the bar slowly and scan for any stretch where the skeleton comes off the person or left and right are swapped.
«사람 찾기 · 관절 분석» 을 누르면 그 단추 자리가 초록 진행률 막대: Press «Find people · analyze joints» and that button's place turns into a green progress bar and a line saying what it is doing right now, with «Cancel» at the right end of the line. That «Cancel» pulls out not only the analysis currently running but also anything waiting its turn from «Add to queue — analyze when the current one finishes». A canceled video simply goes back to «not analyzed»; the uploaded file, the name and the range settings all stay, so you can change the model or the frames per second and press it again. The progress is recorded by the store, not the window, so it carries on from the same place even if you close the window and open it again.
해 볼 것: 자리만 확인하세요. 누르면 몇 분씩 돌던 분석이 버려지고,: Try it: just note where it is. Pressing it throws away an analysis that has been running for minutes, and pressing it again starts over from the first frame.
× — 창 닫기 (분석은 계속 돕니다): × — close the window (the analysis keeps running)
머리줄 오른쪽 끝 × 가 이 창을 닫습니다. 닫아도 돌고 있는 분석은 멈: The × at the right end of the title bar closes this window. Closing it does not stop a running analysis — the store keeps it going, writes it into the project folder as soon as it finishes, and if you reopen it with «Import motion from video» on the timeline tab, you see the progress continue from where it was. You can set a long video going, close the window and work on the composition in the meantime. To really stop the analysis, use «Cancel», not ×. Also, closing with × alone changes not a single character key — keys only go in when you press «Add to timeline», and at that point the window closes by itself.
해 볼 것: 분석을 걸어 둔 채 × 로 닫았다가 «영상 올려서 캐릭터에: Try it: leave an analysis running, close with ×, then reopen with «Upload a video to put motion on a character» and watch the progress carry on.
「창을 닫으면 분석이 날아간다」 고 여겨 몇 분씩 창을 붙들고 기다리는: People used to sit holding the window open for minutes, believing that 「closing the window throws the analysis away」. The analysis is run by the store, not the window.
지난 다듬기 — 무엇을 잇고 무엇을 두었나: Last cleanup — what was smoothed and what was left alone
배치 탭의 «모캡 키 다듬기» 판에서 «자동 다듬기» 나 «AI 분석 다: Once you press «Auto cleanup» or «AI-analyzed cleanup» even once on the «Clean up mocap keys» panel of the layout tab, a collapsed line appears at the very bottom of the panel reading «Last cleanup — AI · N keys changed» («Auto» if it was done by rule). Press the triangle to open it and you get one line per jitter candidate stretch — whether it was «smoothed» or «left», which joint and at roughly what second, and, for AI, why it judged that way — up to 80 lines. This list is the only place where you can see «what the cleanup touched» — if it is all «left», it barely touched anything, so raise the sensitivity to «Sensitive» and run it again; conversely, if a fast motion that should have survived got flattened into «smoothed», undo with Ctrl+Z, lower it to «Dull» and press again. Only the most recent cleanup is kept, and it disappears if you select another character and come back.
해 볼 것: 한 번 «자동 다듬기» 를 누른 뒤 이 줄을 펴서, «둠»: Try it: press «Auto cleanup» once, open this line, and pick just one stretch marked «left» to check whether it really is a fast motion worth keeping.
구도잡기에서 «화면을 직접 만지는» 것만 모아 새 갈래 planner-s: Gathers everything in the Composition Planner about «touching the view directly» into a new track, planner-screen (9 steps) — click empty space to clear the selection · gizmo handles · the value badge that appears while dragging · the crosshair cursor for standing things on the floor · the fps badge during playback · the four control-speed chips · renaming and deleting saved compositions
머리줄 오른쪽, 책 아이콘의 «튜토리얼» 이 이 창 전용 갈래를 펴는 자: «Tutorial», the book icon at the right of the title bar, is where the tracks meant only for this window unfold — window tour · room and environment · placing characters and posing · props · lighting · assets · camera and shots · timeline · reference video · importing motion from video · song · GLB · shortcuts. Composition Planner tracks appear in the list only while this window is open, so this, not the top bar, is the only way in. A track you have been through gets a green check, so a record of how far you got remains.
해 볼 것: 머리줄 오른쪽 끝의 «튜토리얼» 자리를 눈으로 확인해 두세요: Try it: note with your eyes where «Tutorial» sits at the right end of the title bar — when you get stuck mid-work, you come back here and open just the track you are stuck on.
화면에서 고르기 · 빈 곳 눌러 풀기: Selecting in the view · click empty space to clear
Characters and props are selected not only from the list on the right but by clicking them directly in the 3D view. You have to release within 3px of where you pressed for it to count as «a selection»; move further and it is taken as «turning the view», and the selection doesn't change. Click empty space with nothing in it and the selection clears, putting the handles (the gizmo) away — this is where you get rid of the handles when they hide the composition. Selecting stops during playback · while you are dragging a handle · while «Stand on floor» is on.
해 볼 것: 인물을 한 번 눌러 잡은 뒤, 아무것도 없는 빈 하늘을 눌러: Try it: click a character once to grab it, then click the empty sky where there is nothing and see the handles disappear.
손잡이로 끌기 — 화살표 · 링 · 상자: Dragging with the handles — arrow · ring · box
고른 것에 붙는 색 손잡이가 기즈모입니다 — 화살표는 이동, 링은 회전,: The colored handles attached to whatever is selected are the gizmo — arrows move, rings rotate, boxes scale, and you swap between them with the 1 · 2 · 3 keys (red X · green Y · blue Z). Characters · props · GLB · the room are all moved, turned and scaled with the same handles. When you let go, «only the value of the axis you grabbed» is saved, so turning only the Y ring never pulls X and Z out of true with it. For the room, hold Shift while grabbing; the scale you applied is multiplied into the room's dimensions (width · depth · ceiling height) and then the handle returns to 1.
해 볼 것: 인물을 고르고 화살표 하나만 잡아 끌어 보세요. 2 를 누르: Try it: select a character and drag just one arrow. Press 2 and the rotation rings appear in the same place.
잡은 축만 적는 까닭 — 회전은 YXZ 순서로 다시 풀어 저장하는데, 세: Why only the grabbed axis is written — rotation is decomposed again in YXZ order before saving, and if all three axes are overwritten at once, X and Z jump when Y passes 90° and the angle snaps back.
끌면서 뜨는 수치: The values that appear while dragging
손잡이를 끄는 동안 커서 오른쪽 위에 지금 값이 따라다닙니다 — 이동은: While you drag a handle, the current value follows along just above and to the right of the cursor — «X 1.20 m» for a move, «Y −35.0°» for a rotation, «×1.240» for a scale. If you grabbed an axis handle it shows that one axis; if you grabbed the center so all three axes move together, it lists all three side by side. It is «what it is now», not «how far you moved this time», so it is the same value as the number fields in the right panel, and it disappears 1.5 seconds after you let go.
해 볼 것: 회전 링을 천천히 끌면서 커서 옆 숫자가 도(°)로 바뀌는: Try it: drag a rotation ring slowly and watch the number beside the cursor switch to degrees (°), then let go, leave it a moment and see it disappear.
특수 배경 — 도면 · 동선 · 사람 크기 기준: Special background — floor plans, motion paths, human-scale references
구도잡기의 방은 «서 있는 공간» 이지만, 컷을 설명하려고 뽑는 그림은: A room in the Composition Planner is a space you stand in, but images made to explain a cut are something else — a floor plan seen from above, that plan with motion arrows on it, a reference measured against a person: images you read rather than stand in. This button opens a **place card** for making those, and the card it creates stays in the project's place list. The card opens with every composition section expanded — it does not distinguish indoor from outdoor, so chips like bird's-eye, top-down aerial and isometric are visible too.
Try it: Press «Special background» and see which chips the card offers.
«+ 남성형» «+ 여성형» — 이름 없는 사람 자리: «+ Male» «+ Female» — a nameless place for a person
작품에 등록한 인물 말고도 «사람 하나가 여기 선다» 를 세울 수 있습니: Besides the characters registered in the project, you can also stand up a plain «someone stands here». These two buttons do that — a male or female mannequin appears in the middle of the view and a row like «Mannequin 1» joins the list. Use them for a passer-by, for a size reference, or for a counterpart you have not cast yet. A mannequin row carries one extra ×, which removes it from the composition straight from the list.
Try it: Press «+ Male» to stand up one mannequin.
인물 카드를 만들지 않고도 사람 크기를 견줄 수 있어야 합니다 — 방 치: You need to be able to check human scale without creating a character card — whether the room's dimensions are right only becomes clear once a person is standing in it.
그림에 마우스를 올리면 네 귀퉁이에 아이콘이 뜹니다. 왼쪽 위 **겹친: Hover the mouse over an image and icons appear in its four corners. The **overlapping squares** at the top left copy the image to the clipboard so you can paste it straight into an LLM window or a chat. The **×** at the top right removes it from this card (for a reference, only from the list; for a generated result, the original in the folder as well), and the **folder** at the bottom left finds that file in Explorer. The **paper plane** pastes the image onto the Magnific canvas, and the **scissors** opens the image editing window. A reference has one more, a **★**, which nails it down as the «identity reference».
Try it: Hover the mouse over an image and count which icons appear.
아이콘은 평소 투명이라 마우스를 올려야 보입니다. 그림 자체를 가리지 않: The icons are normally transparent, so they only show when you hover. That is to keep them from covering the image itself, but it also makes it easy to end up saying «I had no idea that feature existed» — while the tutorial is pointing at them they stay visible even without hovering.
Once the window is open, drag a rectangle over the image. One box appears. When the mode at the bottom is «Crop» (the scissors), that box is «the panel that will become a file»; when it is «Erase» (the eraser), it is «the spot to be covered with the surrounding color» — the gesture is the same, so check which one you are in before you drag. A cropped image is saved at the original resolution, not at the size shown on screen, and erasing is applied before cropping, so an erased spot shows up in the cropped panel as well.
오른쪽에 상자마다 한 줄이 섭니다. 자르기 상자는 «이 칸의 이름» 칸이: On the right, each box gets its own row. A crop box has a «Name of this panel» field, and that name becomes both the file name and the Magnific @tag. An erase box has a «Covering color» picker instead of a name, and if you leave it alone it averages the colors around the box. Below, «Files to be saved» shows in advance what will be created, under what name and at what size — the numbers are added when you save.
Try it: Give the panel you are going to crop a name such as «Face front».
레퍼런스 구성에 있는 이름을 그대로 쓰면 나중에 어느 칸인지 찾기 쉽습니: If you use the names from the reference composition as they are, it is easy to tell later which panel is which.
탭 다섯 — 자르기 말고도: Five tabs — more than just cropping
이 창은 자르기만 하는 곳이 아닙니다. «표시하기» 는 번호와 도형으로: This window is not only for cropping. «Mark up» points at places with numbers and shapes so you can call one «point ①», and «Motion path» draws the routes the camera, the characters and the light travel as arrows. «Unfold, 6 faces» cuts one cross-shaped unfold into six panels and saves them as a set to hang in a room, and on a wide image one more tab, «Panorama», appears and flattens a single 360° image into six faces.
인물·장소·에셋·컷 어디서 가위를 눌러도 같은 창입니다 — 자리를 짚고: Wherever you press the scissors — a character, a place, an asset or a cut — it is the same window; pointing at places and drawing arrows belongs to images in general, not to characters alone (rule 1).
업스케일 — 칸은 작아지니까: Upscale — because a panel comes out small
칸을 자르면 그림이 작아집니다. 오른쪽 아래에서 이 창이 쓸 엔진을 고르: Cropping a panel makes the image smaller. At the bottom right you choose the engine this window will use and set a target among «2K», «4K», «6K» and «8K» — a size the chosen engine cannot really produce is marked with an asterisk telling you it «will just be a stretched image». Turning on «Upscale and save» enlarges the saved file on the spot and overwrites it, while «Upscale the current image» below it does no cropping at all: it enlarges only the current image and leaves it as a new file.
해 볼 것: 자리만 확인하세요. 누르면 그래픽카드로 몇 분씩 돌고 덮어쓴: Try it: Just check where it is. If you press it, it runs the graphics card for several minutes, and what it overwrites cannot be undone.
설치된 엔진이 하나도 없으면 이 판이 안내문으로 바뀝니다 — 설정 → 업: If no engine is installed at all, this panel turns into a notice — install one under Settings → Upscale engines and it switches on.
상자를 그리면 미리보기가 저절로 만들어지지만, 기다리지 않고 지금 보려면: Drawing a box builds the preview by itself, but to see it right now instead of waiting, press «Refresh preview». If there is an erase box, a «Word to put after 'erased'» field appears on the left, and typing «hand» there leaves the file as «…_erased_hand_001». On the right, the button that spells out what it will do — like «Crop 3 panels · erase 1 spot and save» — is the place that actually creates the files; before that, not a single file is made.
Try it: Press «Refresh preview» and look at the result first.
저장·업스케일이 도는 동안에는 닫기가 잠깁니다. 도중에 닫히면 몇 분 걸: While saving or upscaling is running, closing is locked. If the window closed partway through, work that takes several minutes would keep running off-screen where you cannot watch its progress.
표시하기 — 자리에 번호를 찍습니다: Markup — put numbers on the spots
그림 위의 한 자리를 짚어 «①번 지점» 이라 부를 수 있게 만드는 탭입: This is the tab that lets you point at one spot on the image and call it «point ①». Pick a shape with one of the four buttons and drag on the image to add one more mark — only «Anchor point» behaves differently: click the point where the camera stands and drag toward the side it should face head-on. A description field appears under each mark, and depending on the shape the guidance changes to «where this point is», «a motion path or flow», or «what this area is».
번호가 그림에 구워져야 생성기가 «①번 지점에 인물» 을 알아봅니다. 말: The numbers have to be baked into the image for the generator to recognize «a character at point ①». If you only say «upper left» in words, it interprets it differently every time.
표시를 하나라도 찍으면 이름 칸과 단추가 생깁니다. 이름 칸(기본 «표시: As soon as you place even one mark, a name field and buttons appear. The name field (default «Mark») is the word that goes into the saved file name, so if you type «Anchor A» it is left as «original name_Mark_Anchor A». «Save marked image» bakes the numbers and shapes into a PNG at the original resolution, puts it fresh into this item's folder and also adds it to the generated-image list — the original stays clean while «Anchor A version» and «Anchor B version» pile up. If you want to paste it straight away without leaving a file behind, use «Copy marked image».
그림 위에 화살표 달린 선을 그어 영상 생성기에 움직임을 못 박는 탭입니: This is the tab where you draw arrow-tipped lines on the image to nail the movement down for the video generator. On the left pick a kind among «Camera path» (purple dotted line) · «Character path» (blue solid line) · «Light path» (thin triple line), and with the three buttons beside it choose «View only» · «Freehand line» · «Straight line». «Thickness» applies only to lines you draw from now on, so set it before you draw. «Save motion path image» bakes the lines at the original resolution and leaves them as «original name_motion path».
인물을 고르면 그 아래에 이름·키(cm)·체격 칸이 섭니다. **키가 축: Pick a character and the name · height (cm) · build fields stand up below it. **Height is the scale** — the height a person written as 175 takes up inside the room is drawn against the room's dimensions, and that value goes straight into the prompt. The name field is confirmed with Enter and reverted with Esc (while you are typing, redrawing the 3D is deferred).
해 볼 것: 키를 170 과 190 으로 바꿔 보며 방 안에서 얼마나 달: Try it: switch the height between 170 and 190 and see how much it changes inside the room.
미터만 적으면 생성기가 안 지킵니다. 사람을 세워 견주어야 «이 방이 큰: If you only write meters, the generator will not honor them. Only by standing a person there for comparison does «is this room big or small» survive into the picture.
With two or more characters the mannequins all look the same and you lose track of who is who. Pick one of the twelve chips and only that person turns that color; «Auto» lets the app choose for you. Hold Ctrl to grab several and they are painted the same color at once — use it when you want to tie three people on the same side into one color.
Try it: click one of the color chips and change the character's color.
이 색은 구도를 보는 동안만 쓰는 표식입니다. 캡처와 프롬프트에는 안 나: This color is only a marker used while you are looking at the composition. It does not go out into captures or prompts.
수치 입력 — 이동 · 회전 · 크기, 자유 · 바닥 · 높이: Numeric input — move · rotate · scale, free · floor · height
윗줄은 «무엇을 바꿀까»(이동·회전·크기), 아랫줄은 «어떻게 움직일까»: The top row is «what to change» (move·rotate·scale), the bottom row is «how to move it» (free·floor·height). With «Floor» the feet stay stuck to the floor however you drag, and with «Height» it only moves up and down. Unfold «Position · rotation numbers» below it to type values in directly, and the ↺ next to an axis resets only that one axis to 0. «Reset position·rotation» puts that character as a whole back at its starting spot.
해 볼 것: «바닥» 을 켜고 인물을 끌어 보세요. 발이 바닥에서 안 떨: Try it: turn on «Floor» and drag the character. The feet never leave the floor.
숫자 칸에서는 ↑ ↓ 키로도 바뀝니다 — 이동 0.1m, 회전 15°씩입: In the number fields the ↑ ↓ keys change values too — 0.1m at a time for move, 15° for rotate.
